SELECT f.uniquecarrier, SUM(f.depdelayminutes) AS total_depdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airline_id a ON f.airlineid = a.code WHERE f.month >= 11 AND f.dayofmonth <= 20 GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier HAVING SUM(f.depdelayminutes) > '0' INTERSECT SELECT f.uniquecarrier, SUM(f.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arrdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airport_id ap ON f.destairportid = ap.code WHERE f.distancegroup >= 1 AND f.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier HAVING SUM(f.arrdelayminutes) < '0' ORDER BY 1;

SELECT f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest, AVG(f.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airline_id la ON f.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport lo ON f.origin = lo.code JOIN l_airport ld ON f.dest = ld.code WHERE f.depdelayminutes > '0' AND f.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 33 INTERSECT SELECT f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest, AVG(f.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airline_id la ON f.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport lo ON f.origin = lo.code JOIN l_airport ld ON f.dest = ld.code WHERE f.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND f.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest HAVING COUNT(*) < 284 ORDER BY flight_count DESC;

SELECT f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(f.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON f.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_airport ao ON f.origin = ao.code JOIN l_airport ad ON f.dest = ad.code WHERE f.depdelayminutes > '0' AND f.distance > '100' GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 31 INTERSECT SELECT f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(f.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON f.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_airport ao ON f.origin = ao.code JOIN l_airport ad ON f.dest = ad.code WHERE f.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND f.distance < '100' GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

SELECT f1.uniquecarrier, f1.origin, f1.dest, AVG(f1.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f1 JOIN l_airline_id lai ON f1.airlineid = lai.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_orig ON f1.originairportid = lap_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON f1.destairportid = lap_dest.code WHERE f1.depdelayminutes > '0' AND f1.month >= 5 GROUP BY f1.uniquecarrier, f1.origin, f1.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 38 INTERSECT SELECT f2.uniquecarrier, f2.origin, f2.dest, AVG(f2.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f2 JOIN l_airline_id lai2 ON f2.airlineid = lai2.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_orig2 ON f2.originairportid = lap_orig2.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest2 ON f2.destairportid = lap_dest2.code WHERE f2.arrdelayminutes < '-30' AND f2.dayofweek <= 6 GROUP BY f2.uniquecarrier, f2.origin, f2.dest HAVING AVG(f2.arrdelayminutes) < '-30';

SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_ap_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_ap_dest.description AS dest_airport, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ot.flightdate) AS flight_month, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN ot.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(ot.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(ot.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(ot.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 ot JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON ot.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_origin ON ot.originairportid = l_ap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_dest ON ot.destairportid = l_ap_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf_origin ON ot.originstatefips = l_sf_origin.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf_dest ON ot.deststatefips = l_sf_dest.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON ot.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_airline_id lai ON ot.airlineid = lai.code WHERE ot.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND ot.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND ot.distancegroup >= 1 AND ot.originstatefips IN (SELECT code FROM l_state_fips WHERE code >= 39) GROUP BY l_uc.description, l_ap_origin.description, l_ap_dest.description, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ot.flightdate) HAVING AVG(ot.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND COUNT(*) > 982 ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC;

SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_m.description AS month_name, l_dg.description AS distance_group_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distancegroup >= 3 GROUP BY l_uc.description, l_m.description, l_dg.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_months m ON o.month = m.code JOIN l_quarters q ON o.quarter = q.code WHERE o.depdelay IS NOT NULL AND o.month BETWEEN 8 AND 1 AND o.quarter = 3 GROUP BY o.airlineid, a.description HAVING COUNT(*) >= 116 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

ra.delay_stddev, ra.dep_arr_delay_correlation, ra.flight_volume_rank, ra.punctuality_rank, aa.unique_destinations, aa.total_flights AS origin_airport_flights, aa.avg_dep_delay, aa.avg_arr_delay, origin_city_market_id, lcs.description AS origin_city_name, lst.code AS origin_state_code, lst.description AS origin_state_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.airlineid ORDER BY aa.total_flights origin_city_desc, lcity2.description AS dest_city_desc, lstate.description AS origin_state_desc, lstate2.description AS dest_state_desc, lquarter.description AS quarter_desc, lmonth.description AS month_desc, lweekday.description AS weekday_desc, ldelay.description AS dep_delay_group_desc, ldelay2.description AS arr_delay_group_desc, ldist.description AS distance_group_desc, lcancel.description AS cancel_reason_desc, ldiv.description AS diversion_desc, lresp.description AS yesno_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(oto.flights) AS sum_flights, AVG(oto.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(oto.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(oto.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(oto.diverted) AS total_diverted, SUM(oto.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(oto.carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(oto.weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(oto.nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, SUM(oto.securitydelay) AS total_security_delay, SUM(oto.lateaircraftdelay) AS total_late_aircraft_delay, MAX(oto.depdelayminutes) AS max_dep_delay, MAX(oto.arrdelayminutes) AS max_arr_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oto.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oto.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 oto JOIN l_airline_id la ON oto.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lairport ON oto.originairportid = lairport.code JOIN l_airport_id lairport2 ON oto.destairportid = lairport2.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcity ON oto.origincitymarketid = lcity.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcity2 ON oto.destcitymarketid = lcity2.code JOIN l_state_fips lstate ON oto.originstatefips = lstate.code JOIN l_state_fips lstate2 ON oto.deststatefips = lstate2.code JOIN l_quarters lquarter ON oto.quarter = lquarter.code JOIN l_months lmonth ON oto.month = lmonth.code JOIN l_weekdays lweekday ON oto.dayofweek = lweekday.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups ldelay ON oto.departuredelaygroups = ldelay.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups ldelay2 ON oto.arrivaldelaygroups = ldelay2.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldist ON oto.distancegroup = ldist.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lcancel ON oto.cancellationcode = lcancel.code LEFT JOIN l_diversions ldiv ON oto.diverted = ldiv.code LEFT JOIN l_yesno_resp lresp ON oto.cancelled = lresp.code WHERE (oto.year = 2016 OR oto.year = 2015) AND (oto.quarter IN (4, 2) OR oto.month BETWEEN 12 AND 3) AND (oto.depdelayminutes > '0' OR oto.arrdelayminutes > '0') AND (oto.distance BETWEEN '0' AND '0' OR oto.distancegroup >= 4) AND (oto.cancelled = 1 OR oto.diverted = 0) AND NOT (oto.carrierdelay IS NULL AND oto.weatherdelay IS NULL AND oto.nasdelay IS NULL) AND oto.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND oto.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, oto.dayofmonth, la.description, lairport.description, lairport2.description, lcity.description, lcity2.description, lstate.description, lstate2.description, lquarter.description, lmonth.description, lweekday.description, ldelay.description, ldelay2.description, ldist.description, lcancel.description, ldiv.description, lresp.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 34 AND AVG(oto.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND SUM(oto.distance) > '1000' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT p.airlineid, p.flightnum, p.flightdate, p.origin, p.dest, p.depdelay, p.arrdelay, ac.description AS carrier_name, orig_airport.description AS origin_airport_name, dest_airport.description AS dest_airport_name, orig_city.description AS origin_city, dest_city.description AS dest_city, orig_state.description AS origin_state_name, dest_state.description AS dest_state_name, dep_blk.description AS departure_time_block, arr_blk.description AS arrival_time_block, cancel.description AS cancellation_reason, p.diverted, div_info.description AS diverted_flag_desc FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 p INNER JOIN l_unique_carriers ac ON p.uniquecarrier = ac.code INNER JOIN l_airport orig_airport ON p.origin = orig_airport.code INNER JOIN l_airport dest_airport ON p.dest = dest_airport.code INNER JOIN l_city_market_id orig_city ON p.origincitymarketid = orig_city.code INNER JOIN l_city_market_id dest_city ON p.destcitymarketid = dest_city.code INNER JOIN l_state_fips orig_state_fips_link ON p.originstatefips = orig_state_fips_link.code INNER JOIN l_state_fips dest_state_fips_link ON p.deststatefips = dest_state_fips_link.code INNER JOIN l_state_abr_aviation orig_state ON orig_state_fips_link.code = CAST(orig_state.code AS integer) INNER JOIN l_state_abr_aviation dest_state ON dest_state_fips_link.code = CAST(dest_state.code AS integer) INNER JOIN l_deparrblk dep_blk ON p.deptimeblk = dep_blk.code INNER JOIN l_deparrblk arr_blk ON p.arrtimeblk = arr_blk.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation cancel ON p.cancellationcode = cancel.code LEFT JOIN l_diversions div_info ON p.diverted = div_info.code WHERE p.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND p.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND p.depdelay > 392.85 AND p.arrdelay > 686.43 AND p.distancegroup = 6 AND p.diverted = 1 GROUP BY p.airlineid, p.flightnum, p.flightdate, p.origin, p.dest, p.depdelay, p.arrdelay, ac.description, orig_airport.description, dest_airport.description, orig_city.description, dest_city.description, orig_state.description, dest_state.description, dep_blk.description, arr_blk.description, cancel.description, p.diverted, div_info.description ORDER BY p.flightdate DESC, p.depdelay DESC;

SELECT p.airlineid, p.origin, p.dest, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(p.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(p.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay, SUM(CASE WHEN p.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN p.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 p JOIN l_airline_id a ON p.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport o ON p.origin = o.code JOIN l_airport d ON p.dest = d.code JOIN l_cancellation c ON p.cancellationcode = c.code WHERE p.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND p.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND p.depdelay > 169.43 AND p.arrdelay > 42.27 AND p.distance BETWEEN '50' AND '50' AND p.month IN (4, 12, 7) AND p.dayofweek IN (4, 1) AND p.cancelled = 1 AND p.diverted = 1 GROUP BY p.airlineid, p.origin, p.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 480 AND AVG(p.depdelay) > 67.42 AND AVG(p.arrdelay) > 107.66 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, avg_arrival_delay DESC;

SELECT p.code AS origin_airport_code, p.description AS origin_airport_name, q.code AS dest_airport_code, q.description AS dest_airport_name, a.airlineid, u.description AS carrier_name, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(a.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(a.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay, SUM(a.distance) AS total_distance, MAX(a.flightdate) AS latest_flight_date FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 a INNER JOIN l_airport p ON a.origin = p.code INNER JOIN l_airport q ON a.dest = q.code LEFT JOIN l_airline_id r ON a.airlineid = r.code LEFT JOIN l_unique_carriers u ON a.uniquecarrier = u.code WHERE a.year = 2016 AND a.month BETWEEN 10 AND 4 AND a.depdelay > 71.97 AND a.arrdelay > 4.85 AND a.distancegroup >= 6 GROUP BY p.code, p.description, q.code, q.description, a.airlineid, u.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 984 AND AVG(a.depdelay) > 63.89 ORDER BY total_distance DESC, avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT p.quarter, p.month, p.dayofweek, p.origin, p.dest, p.uniquecarrier, AVG(p.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(p.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 p JOIN l_quarters q ON p.quarter = q.code JOIN l_months m ON p.month = m.code JOIN l_weekdays w ON p.dayofweek = w.code JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON p.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_airport orig ON p.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON p.dest = dest.code WHERE (p.depdelay > 770.0 OR p.arrdelay > 1061.45) AND NOT (p.cancelled = 1 AND p.diverted = 0) AND p.distance BETWEEN '50' AND '50' AND (p.originstatefips = 59 OR p.deststatefips = 25) AND p.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND p.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY p.quarter, p.month, p.dayofweek, p.origin, p.dest, p.uniquecarrier ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, avg_arrival_delay DESC;

SELECT p.uniquecarrier, p.origin, p.dest, AVG(p.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(p.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.distance) AS median_distance, MAX(p.crselapsedtime) AS max_scheduled_elapsed_time, MIN(p.crselapsedtime) AS min_scheduled_elapsed_time FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 p JOIN l_unique_carriers c ON p.uniquecarrier = c.code JOIN l_airport o ON p.origin = o.code JOIN l_airport d ON p.dest = d.code JOIN l_months m ON p.month = m.code JOIN l_quarters q ON p.quarter = q.code JOIN l_weekdays w ON p.dayofweek = w.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 dg ON p.distancegroup = dg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups depdg ON p.departuredelaygroups = depdg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups arrdg ON p.arrivaldelaygroups = arrdg.code JOIN l_yesno_resp canc ON p.cancelled = canc.code JOIN l_yesno_resp divr ON p.diverted = divr.code WHERE p.year = 2016 AND p.month BETWEEN 4 AND 9 AND p.depdelay > 237.4 AND p.arrdelay > 281.08 AND p.distancegroup >= 7 AND p.departuredelaygroups >= 0 AND p.arrivaldelaygroups >= 1 GROUP BY p.uniquecarrier, p.origin, p.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 65 AND AVG(p.depdelay) > 108.64 AND AVG(p.arrdelay) > 118.92 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, avg_arrival_delay DESC, flight_count DESC;

WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, SUM(o.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay_minutes, AVG(o.distance) AS avg_distance, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes > '0' GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter HAVING COUNT(*) > 105 AND AVG(o.distance) > '0' ) SELECT af.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_description, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport_desc, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, lm.description AS month_desc, lq.description AS quarter_desc, af.total_flights, af.total_dep_delay_minutes, af.total_arr_delay_minutes, af.avg_distance, af.total_cancelled, af.total_diverted, af.median_dep_delay, af.median_arr_delay, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank_per_airline, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY af.total_dep_delay_minutes DESC) AS dep_delay_rank, SUM(af.total_flights) OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid, af.quarter) AS airline_quarterly_flights, LAG(af.total_flights, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid, af.originairportid, af.destairportid ORDER BY af.month) AS prev_month_flights FROM aggregated_flights af JOIN l_airline_id la ON af.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_origin ON af.originairportid = lap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON af.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_months lm ON af.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON af.quarter = lq.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON af.total_cancelled > 0 AND lc.code = 'A' LEFT JOIN l_diversions ld ON af.total_diverted > 0 AND ld.code = 1 WHERE af.total_cancelled < 93 AND af.total_diverted < 23 ORDER BY af.total_dep_delay_minutes DESC, af.total_flights DESC LIMIT 2039;

WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, SUM(o.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay_minutes, AVG(o.distance) AS avg_distance, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, SUM(o.depdel15) AS total_dep_del15, SUM(o.arrdel15) AS total_arr_del15 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.quarter = 3 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter ) SELECT la.description AS airline_name, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport, lm.description AS month_name, lq.description AS quarter_name, af.total_flights, af.total_dep_delay_minutes, af.total_arr_delay_minutes, af.avg_distance, af.total_cancelled, af.total_diverted, af.total_dep_del15, af.total_arr_del15, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank_per_airline, SUM(af.total_flights) OVER (PARTITION BY af.originairportid, af.destairportid) AS total_flights_per_route, AVG(af.total_dep_delay_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY af.uniquecarrier) AS avg_dep_delay_per_carrier FROM aggregated_flights af JOIN l_airline_id la ON af.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_origin ON af.originairportid = lap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON af.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_months lm ON af.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON af.quarter = lq.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON af.total_cancelled > 0 AND lc.code = 'A' LEFT JOIN l_diversions ld ON af.total_diverted > 0 AND ld.code = 1 LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg ON af.total_dep_del15 > 0 AND lodg.code = 1 WHERE af.total_flights > 519 AND af.avg_distance BETWEEN '100.0' AND '100.0' GROUP BY la.description, lap_origin.description, lap_dest.description, lm.description, lq.description, af.airlineid, af.uniquecarrier, af.originairportid, af.destairportid, af.total_flights, af.total_dep_delay_minutes, af.total_arr_delay_minutes, af.avg_distance, af.total_cancelled, af.total_diverted, af.total_dep_del15, af.total_arr_del15 HAVING SUM(af.total_cancelled) < 46 OR SUM(af.total_diverted) < 5 ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC, af.total_dep_delay_minutes DESC LIMIT 7825;

WITH flight_agg AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdel15) AS total_dep_delays, SUM(o.arrdel15) AS total_arr_delays, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter ) SELECT la.description AS airline_name, lap_orig.description AS origin_airport, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport, lm.description AS month_name, lq.description AS quarter_name, fa.total_flights, fa.total_dep_delays, fa.total_arr_delays, fa.avg_dep_delay, fa.avg_arr_delay, fa.total_cancelled, fa.total_diverted, fa.total_distance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fa.airlineid ORDER BY fa.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank_per_airline, SUM(fa.total_flights) OVER (PARTITION BY fa.airlineid, fa.quarter) AS airline_quarterly_flights FROM flight_agg fa JOIN l_airline_id la ON fa.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_orig ON fa.originairportid = lap_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON fa.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_months lm ON fa.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON fa.quarter = lq.code WHERE fa.total_flights > 746 AND fa.avg_dep_delay > '0' ORDER BY fa.total_flights DESC, fa.avg_dep_delay DESC;

WITH ranked_flights AS ( SELECT f.year, f.month, f.dayofmonth, f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid, f.depdelayminutes, f.arrdelayminutes, f.distance, f.cancelled, f.diverted, f.carrierdelay, f.weatherdelay, f.nasdelay, f.securitydelay, f.lateaircraftdelay, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid ORDER BY f.depdelayminutes DESC) AS dep_delay_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.uniquecarrier, f.destairportid ORDER BY f.arrdelayminutes DESC) AS arr_delay_rank, SUM(f.flights) OVER (PARTITION BY f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid) AS total_flights_route, AVG(f.distance) OVER (PARTITION BY f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid) AS avg_distance_route FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f WHERE f.year = 2016 AND f.month BETWEEN 5 AND 8 ), carrier_metrics AS ( SELECT rf.uniquecarrier, rf.originairportid, rf.destairportid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, SUM(rf.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay, SUM(rf.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay, MAX(rf.depdelayminutes) AS max_dep_delay, MAX(rf.arrdelayminutes) AS max_arr_delay, AVG(rf.distance) AS avg_distance, SUM(rf.cancelled) AS cancelled_count, SUM(rf.diverted) AS diverted_count, SUM(rf.carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(rf.weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(rf.nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, SUM(rf.securitydelay) AS total_security_delay, SUM(rf.lateaircraftdelay) AS total_late_aircraft_delay, rf.total_flights_route, rf.avg_distance_route FROM ranked_flights rf WHERE rf.dep_delay_rank <= 39 OR rf.arr_delay_rank <= 95 GROUP BY rf.uniquecarrier, rf.originairportid, rf.destairportid, rf.total_flights_route, rf.avg_distance_route HAVING SUM(rf.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND SUM(rf.arrdelayminutes) > '0' ), airport_aggregates AS ( SELECT cm.uniquecarrier, cm.originairportid, cm.destairportid, cm.flight_count, cm.total_dep_delay, cm.total_arr_delay, cm.max_dep_delay, cm.max_arr_delay, cm.avg_distance, cm.cancelled_count, cm.diverted_count, cm.total_carrier_delay, cm.total_weather_delay, cm.total_nas_delay, cm.total_security_delay, cm.total_late_aircraft_delay, cm.total_flights_route, cm.avg_distance_route, lai.description AS airline_desc, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport_desc, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, lcmo.description AS origin_city_market_desc, lcmd.description AS dest_city_market_desc, lsao.description AS origin_state_desc, lsad.description AS dest_state_desc, ldg.description AS distance_group_desc, lq.description AS quarter_desc FROM carrier_metrics cm JOIN l_unique_carriers luc ON cm.uniquecarrier = luc.code JOIN l_airline_id lai ON cm.uniquecarrier = lai.code::character varying JOIN l_airport_id lap_origin ON cm.originairportid = lap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON cm.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcmo ON cm.originairportid = lcmo.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcmd ON cm.destairportid = lcmd.code JOIN l_state_fips lsfo ON cm.originairportid = lsfo.code JOIN l_state_fips lsfd ON cm.destairportid = lsfd.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation lsao ON lsfo.code = lsao.code::integer JOIN l_state_abr_aviation lsad ON lsfd.code = lsad.code::integer JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON cm.avg_distance_route::integer = ldg.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON (SELECT quarter FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE uniquecarrier = cm.uniquecarrier AND originairportid = cm.originairportid AND destairportid = cm.destairportid LIMIT 1) = lq.code WHERE cm.flight_count > 7039 AND cm.avg_distance BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ) SELECT aa.uniquecarrier, aa.airline_desc, aa.originairportid, aa.origin_airport_desc, aa.destairportid, aa.dest_airport_desc, aa.origin_city_market_desc, aa.dest_city_market_desc, aa.origin_state_desc, aa.dest_state_desc, aa.flight_count, aa.total_dep_delay, aa.total_arr_delay, aa.max_dep_delay, aa.max_arr_delay, aa.avg_distance, aa.cancelled_count, aa.diverted_count, aa.total_carrier_delay, aa.total_weather_delay, aa.total_nas_delay, aa.total_security_delay, aa.total_late_aircraft_delay, aa.total_flights_route, aa.avg_distance_route, aa.distance_group_desc, aa.quarter_desc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY aa.total_dep_delay DESC) AS dep_delay_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY aa.total_arr_delay DESC) AS arr_delay_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY aa.flight_count DESC) AS flight_count_rank FROM airport_aggregates aa WHERE aa.cancelled_count < 126 AND aa.diverted_count < 668 ORDER BY aa.total_dep_delay DESC, aa.total_arr_delay DESC, aa.flight_count DESC LIMIT 71;

SELECT f1.uniquecarrier, f1.origin, f1.dest, f1.month, f1.dayofmonth, AVG(f1.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, SUM(f1.flights) AS total_flights, COUNT(DISTINCT f1.tailnum) AS unique_aircraft, MAX(f1.distance) AS max_distance, MIN(f1.arrdelayminutes) AS min_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f1 JOIN l_airline_id lai ON f1.airlineid = lai.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_orig ON quarter_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o1.flights) AS weighted_flights, AVG(o1.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o2.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o1.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(CASE WHEN o1.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o1.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_flights, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o1.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o2.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay, CORR(o1.depdelayminutes, o2.arrdelayminutes) AS delay_correlation FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o1 JOIN on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 ON o1.uniquecarrier = o2.uniquecarrier AND o1.flightdate = o2.flightdate AND o1.flightnum = o2.flightnum AND o1.originairportid = o2.originairportid AND o1.destairportid = o2.destairportid AND o1.year = o2.year AND o1.quarter = o2.quarter AND o1.month = o2.month AND o1.dayofmonth = o2.dayofmonth AND o1.airlineid = o2.airlineid AND o1.originairportseqid = o2.originairportseqid AND o1.destairportseqid = o2.destairportseqid AND o1.origincitymarketid = o2.origincitymarketid AND o1.destcitymarketid = o2.destcitymarketid AND o1.originstatefips = o2.originstatefips AND o1.deststatefips = o2.deststatefips AND o1.originwac = o2.originwac AND o1.destwac = o2.destwac AND o1.distancegroup = o2.distancegroup AND o1.cancelled = o2.cancelled AND o1.diverted = o2.diverted JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o1.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_airport l_ap1 ON o1.origin = l_ap1.code JOIN l_airport l_ap2 ON o2.dest = l_ap2.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o1.month = l_m.code JOIN l_quarters l_q ON o1.quarter = l_q.code JOIN l_airline_id l_ai ON o1.airlineid = l_ai.code JOIN l_airport_id l_api1 ON o1.originairportid = l_api1.code JOIN l_airport_id l_api2 ON o2.destairportid = l_api2.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id l_apsi1 ON o1.originairportseqid = l_apsi1.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id l_apsi2 ON o2.destairportseqid = l_apsi2.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_cmi1 ON o1.origincitymarketid = l_cmi1.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_cmi2 ON o2.destcitymarketid = l_cmi2.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf1 ON o1.originstatefips = l_sf1.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf2 ON o2.deststatefips = l_sf2.code JOIN l_world_area_codes l_wac1 ON o1.originwac = l_wac1.code JOIN l_world_area_codes l_wac2 ON o2.destwac = l_wac2.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o1.distancegroup = l_dg.code JOIN l_yesno_resp l_yn1 ON o1.cancelled = l_yn1.code JOIN l_yesno_resp l_yn2 ON o1.diverted = l_yn2.code WHERE o1.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o2.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND o1.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o1.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o1.distance >= '0' AND o1.cancelled = 1 AND o1.diverted = 1 AND o1.year = 2016 GROUP BY o1.uniquecarrier, o1.origin, o2.dest, l_uc.description, l_ap1.description, l_ap2.description, l_m.description, l_q.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 121 AND AVG(o1.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND AVG(o2.arrdelayminutes) > '0' AND SUM(o1.distance) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC LIMIT 425;

lap_dest ON oto.destairportid = lap_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON oto.cancellationcode = lc.code INNER JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON oto.distancegroup = ldg.code INNER JOIN l_quarters lq ON oto.quarter = lq.code INNER JOIN l_months lm ON oto.month = lm.code INNER JOIN l_weekdays lw ON oto.dayofweek = lw.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_dep ON oto.departuredelaygroups = lodg_dep.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_arr ON oto.arrivaldelaygroups = lodg_arr.code LEFT JOIN l_state_fips lsf_origin ON oto.originstatefips = lsf_origin.code LEFT JOIN l_state_fips lsf_dest ON oto.deststatefips = lsf_dest.code WHERE oto.year = 2016 AND oto.distance >= '0' AND oto.depdelayminutes > '0' AND oto.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' GROUP BY median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oto.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay, SUM(oto.carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(oto.weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, ON oto.quarter = lq.code JOIN l_months lm ON oto.month = lm.code JOIN l_weekdays lw ON oto.dayofweek = lw.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON oto.distancegroup = ldg.code WHERE oto.year = 2016 AND oto.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND (oto.depdelayminutes > '0' OR oto.arrdelayminutes > '0') AND (oto.cancelled = 0 OR oto.diverted = 0) AND NOT (oto.originstatefips = 43 AND oto.deststatefips = 68) AND oto.distancegroup BETWEEN 4 AND 8 AND (oto.carrierdelay > 16.85 OR oto.weatherdelay > 244.37 OR oto.nasdelay > 178.86 OR oto.securitydelay > 189.59 OR oto.lateaircraftdelay SELECT oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, oto.dayofmonth, oto.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_desc, oto.origin, lap_o.description AS origin_airport_desc, oto.dest, lap_d.description AS dest_airport_desc, oto.cancelled, lc.description AS cancellation_desc, oto.diverted, ld.description AS diversion_desc, oto.depdelay, oto.depdelayminutes, oto.arrdelay, oto.arrdelayminutes, DESC) AS flight_volume_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 oto LEFT JOIN l_airline_id la ON oto.airlineid = la.code LEFT JOIN l_airport_id lap_o ON oto.originairportid = lap_o.code LEFT JOIN l_airport_id lap_d ON oto.destairportid = lap_d.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON oto.cancellationcode = lc.code LEFT JOIN l_diversions ld ON oto.diverted = ld.code LEFT JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON oto.distancegroup = ldg.code LEFT JOIN l_months lm ON oto.month = lm.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_dep ON oto.departuredelaygroups = lodg_dep.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_arr ON oto.arrivaldelaygroups = lodg_arr.code LEFT JOIN l_quarters lq ON oto.quarter = lq.code LEFT JOIN l_state_fips lsf_o ON oto.originstatefips = lsf_o.code LEFT JOIN l_state_fips lsf_d ON oto.deststatefips = lsf_d.code LEFT JOIN l_unique_carriers luc ON oto.uniquecarrier = luc.code LEFT JOIN l_weekdays lw ON oto.dayofweek = lw.code LEFT JOIN l_world_area_codes lwac_o ON oto.originwac = lwac_o.code LEFT JOIN l_world_area_codes lwac_d ON oto.destwac = lwac_d.code LEFT JOIN l_yesno_resp lynr_c ON oto.cancelled = lynr_c.code LEFT JOIN l_yesno_resp lynr_d ON oto.diverted = lynr_d.code WHERE oto.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND oto.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND oto.distance >= '0' AND oto.depdelayminutes > '0' AND oto.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND oto.cancelled = 1 AND oto.diverted = 1 GROUP BY oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, oto.dayofmonth, oto.uniquecarrier, la.description, oto.origin, lap_o.description, oto.dest, lap_d.description, oto.cancelled, lc.description, oto.diverted, ld.description, oto.depdelay, oto.depdelayminutes, oto.arrdelay, oto.arrdelayminutes HAVING SUM(oto.flights) > '0' AND AVG(oto.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC;

WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_depdelay, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_depdelay, SUM(o.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arrdelay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arrdelay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(o.flights) AS total_flight_count, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes > '0' GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '10' AND SUM(o.distance) > '1000' ) SELECT a.code AS airline_code, a.description AS airline_name, ap_origin.code AS origin_airport_code, ap_origin.description AS origin_airport_name, ap_dest.code AS dest_airport_code, ap_dest.description AS dest_airport_name, m.code AS month_code, m.description AS month_name, q.code AS quarter_code, q.description AS quarter_name, dg.code AS distance_group_code, dg.description AS distance_group_name, af.total_flights, af.total_depdelay, af.avg_depdelay, af.total_arrdelay, af.avg_arrdelay, af.total_distance, af.total_flight_count, af.total_cancelled, af.total_diverted, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY af.quarter ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank_by_quarter, LAG(af.total_flights, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid, af.originairportid, af.destairportid ORDER BY af.month) AS prev_month_flights, SUM(af.total_flights) OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid, af.quarter ORDER BY af.month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_flights FROM aggregated_flights af JOIN l_airline_id a ON af.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport_id ap_origin ON af.originairportid = ap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id ap_dest ON af.destairportid = ap_dest.code JOIN l_months m ON af.month = m.code JOIN l_quarters q ON af.quarter = q.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 dg ON FLOOR(af.total_distance / 250) = dg.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation c ON af.total_cancelled > 0 AND c.code = 'A' LEFT JOIN l_diversions dv ON af.total_diverted > 0 AND dv.code = 1 WHERE af.total_flights > 538 AND af.total_distance BETWEEN '0' AND '500000' ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC, af.avg_depdelay DESC LIMIT 947;

WITH flight_metrics AS ( SELECT f.year, f.quarter, f.month, f.dayofmonth, f.uniquecarrier, f.airlineid, f.originairportid, f.destairportid, f.distance, f.distancegroup, f.depdelayminutes, f.arrdelayminutes, f.cancelled, f.diverted, f.carrierdelay, f.weatherdelay, f.nasdelay, f.securitydelay, f.lateaircraftdelay, f.actualelapsedtime, f.airtime, f.flights, la.description AS airline_name, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport_name, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_name, lc_origin.description AS origin_city_name, lc_dest.description AS dest_city_name, ls_origin.description AS origin_state_name, ls_dest.description AS dest_state_name, lq.description AS quarter_name, lm.description AS month_name, ld.description AS weekday_name, lcan.description AS cancellation_reason, ldiv.description AS diversion_status, ldg.description AS distance_group_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.airlineid, f.quarter ORDER BY f.depdelayminutes DESC NULLS LAST) AS dep_delay_rank, AVG(f.arrdelayminutes) OVER (PARTITION BY f.airlineid, f.month) AS airline_monthly_avg_arrdelay, SUM(f.flights) OVER (PARTITION BY f.originairportid ORDER BY f.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS origin_30day_flight_count, LAG(f.depdelayminutes, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest ORDER BY f.flightdate) AS prev_flight_depdelay, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY f.distancegroup ORDER BY f.actualelapsedtime) AS elapsed_time_percentile FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f LEFT JOIN l_airline_id la ON f.airlineid = la.code LEFT JOIN l_airport_id lap_origin ON f.originairportid = lap_origin.code LEFT JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON f.destairportid = lap_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_city_market_id lc_origin ON f.origincitymarketid = lc_origin.code LEFT JOIN l_city_market_id lc_dest ON f.destcitymarketid = lc_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_state_fips ls_origin ON f.originstatefips = ls_origin.code LEFT JOIN l_state_fips ls_dest ON f.deststatefips = ls_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_quarters lq ON f.quarter = lq.code LEFT JOIN l_months lm ON f.month = lm.code LEFT JOIN l_weekdays ld ON f.dayofweek = ld.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lcan ON f.cancellationcode = lcan.code LEFT JOIN l_diversions ldiv ON f.diverted = ldiv.code LEFT JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON f.distancegroup = ldg.code WHERE f.year = 2016 AND f.quarter BETWEEN 1 AND 1 AND f.distance >= '100' AND f.depdelayminutes > '0' AND f.cancelled = 1 ) SELECT airlineid, uniquecarrier, airline_name, quarter, quarter_name, month, month_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(flights) AS total_flight_units, AVG(depdelayminutes) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arrival_delay, SUM(cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(diverted) AS diverted_flights, AVG(distance) AS avg_distance, MAX(depdelayminutes) AS max_departure_delay, MAX(arrdelayminutes) AS max_arrival_delay, SUM(carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, SUM(securitydelay) AS total_security_delay, SUM(lateaircraftdelay) AS total_late_aircraft_delay, AVG(airline_monthly_avg_arrdelay) AS overall_airline_monthly_avg, AVG(origin_30day_flight_count) AS avg_30day_origin_traffic, CORR(depdelayminutes, arrdelayminutes) AS dep_arr_delay_correlation, STDDEV(actualelapsedtime) AS elapsed_time_stddev FROM flight_metrics WHERE dep_delay_rank <= 86 AND elapsed_time_percentile >= '0.0' AND prev_flight_depdelay IS NOT NULL GROUP BY airlineid, uniquecarrier, airline_name, quarter, quarter_name, month, month_name HAVING AVG(arrdelayminutes) > '0' AND COUNT(*) >= 76 AND SUM(flights) > '5' AND AVG(distance) BETWEEN '100' AND '1000' ORDER BY avg_arrival_delay DESC, total_flights DESC LIMIT 764;

WITH flight_metrics AS ( SELECT f.year, f.quarter, f.month, f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid, f.distancegroup, f.cancelled, f.diverted, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(f.flights) AS weighted_flights, AVG(f.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(f.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(f.depdel15) AS total_dep_delays, SUM(f.arrdel15) AS total_arr_delays, SUM(f.carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(f.weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(f.nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, SUM(f.securitydelay) AS total_security_delay, SUM(f.lateaircraftdelay) AS total_late_aircraft_delay, SUM(f.distance) AS total_distance, MAX(f.depdelayminutes) AS max_dep_delay, MAX(f.arrdelayminutes) AS max_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f WHERE f.year = 2016 AND f.quarter = 4 AND f.distancegroup >= 1 AND f.depdelayminutes <= '0' AND f.arrdelayminutes <= '0' GROUP BY f.year, f.quarter, f.month, f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid, f.distancegroup, f.cancelled, f.diverted ), carrier_rankings AS ( SELECT fm.*, la.description AS airline_name, lair.description AS airport_origin_name, laird.description AS airport_dest_name, ldg.description AS distance_group_desc, lc.description AS cancellation_desc, ld.description AS diversion_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.uniquecarrier, fm.month ORDER BY fm.total_flights DESC ) AS flight_rank, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.distancegroup, fm.cancelled ORDER BY fm.avg_dep_delay DESC ) AS delay_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.quarter, fm.diverted ORDER BY fm.total_distance DESC ) AS distance_rank, SUM(fm.total_flights) OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.uniquecarrier, fm.year, fm.quarter ) AS carrier_quarter_total, AVG(fm.avg_arr_delay) OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.originairportid, fm.destairportid ) AS route_avg_delay, LAG(fm.total_flights, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.uniquecarrier ORDER BY fm.month ) AS prev_month_flights, LEAD(fm.avg_dep_delay, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.uniquecarrier ORDER BY fm.month ) AS next_month_dep_delay FROM flight_metrics fm JOIN l_unique_carriers la ON fm.uniquecarrier = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lair ON fm.originairportid = lair.code JOIN l_airport_id laird ON fm.destairportid = laird.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON fm.distancegroup = ldg.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON fm.cancelled::text = lc.code LEFT JOIN l_diversions ld ON fm.diverted = ld.code WHERE fm.total_flights >= 541 AND fm.weighted_flights > '0.1' AND fm.total_distance >= '100' ), aggregated_analysis AS ( SELECT cr.airline_name, cr.airport_origin_name, cr.airport_dest_name, cr.distance_group_desc, cr.cancellation_desc, cr.diversion_desc, cr.year, cr.quarter, cr.month, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.uniquecarrier) AS unique_carriers_count, SUM(cr.total_flights) AS grand_total_flights, SUM(cr.weighted_flights) AS grand_weighted_flights, AVG(cr.avg_dep_delay) AS overall_avg_dep_delay, AVG(cr.avg_arr_delay) AS overall_avg_arr_delay, SUM(cr.total_dep_delays) AS overall_dep_delays, SUM(cr.total_arr_delays) AS overall_arr_delays, SUM(cr.total_carrier_delay) AS overall_carrier_delay, SUM(cr.total_weather_delay) AS overall_weather_delay, SUM(cr.total_nas_delay) AS overall_nas_delay, SUM(cr.total_security_delay) AS overall_security_delay, SUM(cr.total_late_aircraft_delay) AS overall_late_aircraft_delay, SUM(cr.total_distance) AS overall_total_distance, MAX(cr.max_dep_delay) AS overall_max_dep_delay, MAX(cr.max_arr_delay) AS overall_max_arr_delay, AVG(cr.route_avg_delay) AS avg_route_delay, SUM(cr.carrier_quarter_total) AS carrier_quarter_aggregate, CORR(cr.total_flights, cr.avg_dep_delay) AS flights_delay_correlation, STDDEV(cr.avg_arr_delay) AS arr_delay_stddev FROM carrier_rankings cr WHERE cr.flight_rank <= 54 AND cr.delay_rank <= 29 AND cr.distance_rank >= 45 GROUP BY cr.airline_name, cr.airport_origin_name, cr.airport_dest_name, cr.distance_group_desc, cr.cancellation_desc, cr.diversion_desc, cr.year, cr.quarter, cr.month HAVING SUM(cr.total_flights) >= 2133 AND AVG(cr.avg_dep_delay) <= '0' AND SUM(cr.total_distance) >= '1000' ) SELECT aa.*, lm.description AS month_name, lq.description AS quarter_name, lw.description AS weekday_avg_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY aa.airline_name, aa.quarter ORDER BY aa.grand_total_flights DESC ) AS airline_quarter_rank, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY aa.distance_group_desc ORDER BY aa.overall_avg_dep_delay DESC ) AS distance_group_delay_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY aa.year, aa.month ORDER BY aa.overall_total_distance SELECT o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_depdelay, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_depdelay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid ORDER BY SUM(o.depdelayminutes) DESC) AS airline_delay_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lori ON o.originairportid = lori.code JOIN l_airport_id ldes ON o.destairportid = ldes.code JOIN l_months lm ON o.month = lm.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.month >= 12 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month HAVING COUNT(*) > 36 ORDER BY total_depdelay DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.depdelayminutes, o.arrdelayminutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) OVER (PARTITION BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_dep_delay_7day, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin ORDER BY o.depdelayminutes DESC) AS dep_delay_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport lo ON o.origin = lo.code JOIN l_airport ld ON o.dest = ld.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON o.distancegroup = ldg.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND o.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND o.distancegroup >= 10 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.depdelayminutes, o.arrdelayminutes HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY o.flightdate, o.uniquecarrier, o.origin;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdel15) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_dep_del15, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 11 FOLLOWING ) AS rolling_flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distancegroup = 21 AND o.diverted = 0 ORDER BY o.airlineid, o.flightdate;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.origin, o.dest, o.arrdelay, AVG(o.arrdelay) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 24 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_arrdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-02' AND o.arrdelay IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier, AVG(o.depdel15) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_depdel15, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance > 4872.15 AND o.airlineid = 19346 ORDER BY o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier, o.flightdate;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier, AVG(o.depdel15) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_depdel15, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance > 746.51 AND o.airlineid = 19379 ORDER BY o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier, o.flightdate;

SELECT o.flightnum, o.origin, o.dest, a1.description AS origin_airport, a2.description AS dest_airport, c.description AS carrier_name, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airport a1 ON o.origin = a1.code JOIN l_airport a2 ON o.dest = a2.code JOIN l_unique_carriers c ON o.uniquecarrier = c.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.month BETWEEN 11 AND 2 AND o.depdelay IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.flightnum, o.origin, o.dest, a1.description, a2.description, c.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelay) > 46.47 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.flightnum, o.origin, o.dest, o.arrdelay, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.origin ORDER BY o.arrdelay DESC) AS delay_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.arrdelay IS NOT NULL AND o.month = 7 AND o.dayofweek = 2 ORDER BY o.origin, delay_rank;

SELECT o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.depdelay IS NOT NULL AND ( (o.month = 12 AND o.dayofweek = 5) OR (o.distance > '100' AND o.diverted = 1) ) AND NOT (o.cancelled = 1) GROUP BY o.origin, o.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.diverted, o.arrdelay, l.code AS cancellation_code, l.description AS cancellation_reason FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o LEFT JOIN l_cancellation l ON o.cancellationcode = l.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.diverted = 1 AND o.arrdelay > 7.32 AND l.code IS NULL ORDER BY o.flightdate DESC, o.arrdelay DESC;

SELECT o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.uniquecarrier, o.depdel15, o.arrdel15, o.diverted, o.cancelled, o.cancellationcode, l_c.code AS cancellation_code_desc, l_u.description AS carrier_name, l_o.description AS origin_airport_name, l_d.description AS dest_airport_name FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o LEFT JOIN l_cancellation l_c ON o.cancellationcode = l_c.code LEFT JOIN l_unique_carriers l_u ON o.uniquecarrier = l_u.code LEFT JOIN l_airport l_o ON o.origin = l_o.code LEFT JOIN l_airport l_d ON o.dest = l_d.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.month BETWEEN 9 AND 8 AND o.distance > '100.0' AND (o.cancelled = 1 OR o.diverted = 1) ORDER BY o.flightdate DESC, o.depdel15 DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(o.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.quarter = 2 AND o.month = 11 AND o.dayofweek = 2 AND o.distancegroup = 18 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier HAVING COUNT(*) > 745 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, MAX(o.distance) AS max_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 WHERE o2.originairportid = o.originairportid AND o2.destairportid = o.destairportid AND o2.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o2.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o2.depdelay > 165.9 ) AND o.quarter = 3 AND o.distancegroup = 23 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier HAVING AVG(o.arrdelay) > -3.24 ORDER BY flight_count DESC, avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, o.origin, l_a.description AS origin_airport, o.dest, l_a2.description AS dest_airport, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.depdelayminutes) DESC) AS delay_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_airport l_a ON o.origin = l_a.code JOIN l_airport l_a2 ON o.dest = l_a2.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description, o.origin, l_a.description, o.dest, l_a2.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 14 ORDER BY total_dep_delay_minutes DESC;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.airlineid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT airlineid FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE month IN ( SELECT code FROM l_months WHERE code BETWEEN 2 AND 9 ) AND originstatefips = 66 ) AND o.distancegroup >= 6 AND o.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest HAVING AVG(o.depdelay) > 85.78 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, flight_count DESC;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.airlineid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT airlineid FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE month IN ( SELECT code FROM l_months WHERE code BETWEEN 3 AND 12 ) AND originstatefips = 44 ) AND o.distancegroup >= 19 AND o.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest HAVING AVG(o.depdelay) > 78.74 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, flight_count DESC;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.airlineid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT airlineid FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE month IN ( SELECT code FROM l_months WHERE code BETWEEN 5 AND 11 ) AND originstatefips = 18 ) AND o.distancegroup >= 21 AND o.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest HAVING AVG(o.depdelay) > 25.77 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, flight_count DESC;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.airlineid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT airlineid FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE originstatefips IN ( SELECT code FROM l_state_fips WHERE code BETWEEN 51 AND 24 ) AND flightdate >= '2016-01-01' ) AND o.distancegroup = 21 AND o.quarter = 2 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest HAVING AVG(o.depdelay) > 1.65 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.arrdelay, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.origin ORDER BY o.arrdelay DESC) AS delay_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.arrdelay IS NOT NULL AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.originstatefips = 4 ORDER BY o.origin, delay_rank;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.arrdelay, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.origin ORDER BY o.arrdelay DESC) AS delay_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.arrdelay IS NOT NULL AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.originstatefips = 7 ORDER BY o.origin, delay_rank;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_flights, AVG(CASE WHEN o.arrdelay IS NOT NULL THEN o.arrdelay ELSE NULL END) AS avg_arrival_delay, AVG(CASE WHEN o.depdelay IS NOT NULL THEN o.depdelay ELSE NULL END) AS avg_departure_delay, MAX(o.distance) AS max_distance, MIN(o.distance) AS min_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_months m ON o.month = m.code JOIN l_quarters q ON o.quarter = q.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.month BETWEEN 7 AND 6 AND o.distance >= '0' AND o.airlineid IN ( SELECT code FROM l_airline_id WHERE code BETWEEN 19084 AND 19699 ) GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid HAVING COUNT(*) > 349 AND AVG(o.arrdelay) > 271.05 ORDER BY o.year DESC, o.quarter, avg_arrival_delay DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code WHERE o.month IN (SELECT code FROM l_months WHERE code BETWEEN 12 AND 10) AND o.distancegroup IN (SELECT code FROM l_distance_group_250 WHERE code >= 24) AND o.airlineid IN (SELECT code FROM l_airline_id WHERE code IN (19528, 19085)) GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, a.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelay) > 65.07 ORDER BY total_distance DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code WHERE o.month IN (SELECT code FROM l_months WHERE code BETWEEN 3 AND 5) AND o.distancegroup IN (SELECT code FROM l_distance_group_250 WHERE code >= 5) AND o.airlineid IN (SELECT code FROM l_airline_id WHERE code IN (19772, 19681)) GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, a.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelay) > 22.94 ORDER BY total_distance DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightnum, o.depdelay, o.arrdelay, AVG(o.depdelay) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_dep_delay, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.quarter ORDER BY o.arrdelay DESC) AS arrdelay_rank_in_quarter FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.depdelay > 39.55 AND o.arrdelay > 4.13 AND o.distancegroup = 21 ORDER BY o.airlineid, o.quarter, arrdelay_rank_in_quarter;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightnum, o.depdelay, o.arrdelay, AVG(o.depdelay) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_delay, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.quarter ORDER BY o.arrdelay DESC) AS delay_rank_in_quarter FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.depdelay > 74.87 AND o.arrdelay > 157.87 AND o.distancegroup = 9 ORDER BY o.airlineid, o.quarter, delay_rank_in_quarter;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, (SELECT AVG(depdelayminutes) FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE uniquecarrier = o.uniquecarrier AND month = o.month AND depdelayminutes > 0) AS avg_delay_for_carrier_month FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON o.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_airline_id aid ON o.airlineid = aid.code JOIN l_airport ap_origin ON o.origin = ap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id apid_origin ON o.originairportid = apid_origin.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id aseq_origin ON o.originairportseqid = aseq_origin.code JOIN l_city_market_id cid_origin ON o.origincitymarketid = cid_origin.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation s_origin ON o.originstate = s_origin.code JOIN l_state_fips sf_origin ON o.originstatefips = sf_origin.code JOIN l_airport ap_dest ON o.dest = ap_dest.code JOIN l_airport_id apid_dest ON o.destairportid = apid_dest.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id aseq_dest ON o.destairportseqid = aseq_dest.code JOIN l_city_market_id cid_dest ON o.destcitymarketid = cid_dest.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation s_dest ON o.deststate = s_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips sf_dest ON o.deststatefips = sf_dest.code WHERE o.distance > '100' AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier HAVING COUNT(*) > 314 ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM l_airline_id la WHERE la.code = o.airlineid AND la.description ILIKE '%airline%' ) AND o.distancegroup BETWEEN 11 AND 11 AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_a.description AS origin_airport, l_sa.description AS dest_state, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.flights) AS sum_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, MAX(o.distancegroup) AS max_distance_group, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ai ON o.originairportid = l_ai.code JOIN l_airport l_a ON o.origin = l_a.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation l_sa ON o.deststate = l_sa.code JOIN l_airline_id l_ali ON o.airlineid = l_ali.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id l_asi ON o.originairportseqid = l_asi.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_cmi ON o.origincitymarketid = l_cmi.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf ON o.originstatefips = l_sf.code JOIN l_world_area_codes l_wac ON o.originwac = l_wac.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups l_odg ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = l_odg.code JOIN l_deparrblk l_db ON o.deptimeblk = l_db.code JOIN l_yesno_resp l_yn ON o.cancelled = l_yn.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance >= '0' AND o.airlineid IN ( SELECT l_ali2.code FROM l_airline_id l_ali2 JOIN on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 ON l_ali2.code = o2.airlineid WHERE o2.year = 2016 AND o2.quarter = 3 AND o2.cancelled = 0 AND o2.diverted = 0 GROUP BY l_ali2.code HAVING COUNT(*) > 2974 AND AVG(o2.arrdelayminutes) < '0' ) GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description, l_a.description, l_sa.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND SUM(o.distance) > '1000' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_arr_delay ASC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_ap_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_ap_dest.description AS dest_airport, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o INNER JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code INNER JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_origin ON o.originairportid = l_ap_origin.code INNER JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_dest ON o.destairportid = l_ap_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation l_c ON o.cancellationcode = l_c.code LEFT JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.month BETWEEN 5 AND 3 AND o.distance >= '0' GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description, l_ap_origin.description, l_ap_dest.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND COUNT(*) > 762 ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC;

state_fips, COALESCE(sa.state_name, 'ALL_STATES') AS state_name, COALESCE(dga.distancegroup::text, 'ALL_DISTANCE_GROUPS') AS distance_group, COALESCE(dga.distance_group_desc, 'ALL_DISTANCE_GROUPS') AS total_severe_arr_delays, SUM(ca.cancelled_flights) AS total_cancelled, SUM(ca.diverted_flights) AS total_diverted, AVG(ca.avg_dep_delay) AS overall_avg_dep_delay, AVG(ca.avg_arr_delay) AS l_yesno_resp lyn_diverted ON oto.diverted = lyn_diverted.code JOIN l_deparrblk ldb_dep ON oto.deptimeblk = ldb_dep.code JOIN l_deparrblk ldb_arr ON oto.arrtimeblk = ldb_arr.code WHERE oto.year = 2016 AND oto.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND oto.distance >= '0' AND oto.depdelayminutes >= '0' AND oto.arrdelayminutes >= '0' GROUP BY oto.uniquecarrier, la.description, lap_origin.description, lap_dest.description, lc.description, ldg.description, lodg.description, lq.description, lm.description, lw.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 841 AND AVG(oto.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND AVG(oto.arrdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay_min DESC LIMIT 132;

SELECT oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, oto.dayofmonth, la.description AS airline_desc, lairport_o.description AS origin_airport_desc, lairport_d.description AS dest_airport_desc, lcity_o.description AVG(oto.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_min, SUM(oto.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(oto.diverted) AS total_diverted, SUM(oto.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(oto.carrierdelay) AS FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 oto JOIN l_airline_id la ON oto.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lairport_o ON oto.originairportid = lairport_o.code JOIN l_airport_id lairport_d ON oto.destairportid = lairport_d.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcity_o ON oto.origincitymarketid = lcity_o.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcity_d ON oto.destcitymarketid = lcity_d.code JOIN l_state_fips lstate_o ON oto.originstatefips = lstate_o.code JOIN l_state_fips lstate_d ON oto.deststatefips = lstate_d.code JOIN l_unique_carriers lcarrier ON oto.uniquecarrier = lcarrier.code JOIN l_months lmonths ON oto.month = lmonths.code JOIN l_weekdays lweekdays ON oto.dayofweek = lweekdays.code JOIN l_quarters lquarters ON oto.quarter = lquarters.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON oto.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg ON oto.arrivaldelaygroups = lodg.code JOIN l_yesno_resp lyesno ON oto.cancelled = lyesno.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lcanc ON oto.cancellationcode = lcanc.code WHERE (oto.year = 2016 OR oto.year = 2015) AND oto.month BETWEEN 6 AND 4 AND oto.dayofmonth >= 17 AND (oto.depdelayminutes > '0' OR oto.arrdelayminutes > '0') AND oto.distance >= '0' AND (oto.cancelled = 0 OR (oto.cancelled = 1 AND oto.cancellationcode IS NOT NULL)) AND NOT (oto.diverted = 1 AND oto.divairportlandings > 2) AND oto.flightnum IS NOT NULL AND oto.tailnum IS NOT NULL GROUP BY oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, oto.dayofmonth, la.description, lairport_o.description, lairport_d.description, lcity_o.description, lcity_d.description, WITH flight_agg AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdel15) AS total_dep_delays, SUM(o.arrdel15) AS total_arr_delays, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter ) SELECT la.description AS airline_name, lap_orig.description AS origin_airport, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport, lm.description AS month_name, lq.description AS quarter_name, fa.total_flights, fa.total_dep_delays, fa.total_arr_delays, fa.avg_dep_delay, fa.avg_arr_delay, fa.total_cancelled, fa.total_diverted, fa.total_distance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fa.airlineid ORDER BY fa.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank_per_airline, SUM(fa.total_flights) OVER (PARTITION BY fa.airlineid, fa.quarter) AS airline_quarterly_flights FROM flight_agg fa JOIN l_airline_id la ON fa.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_orig ON fa.originairportid = lap_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON fa.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_months lm ON fa.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON fa.quarter = lq.code WHERE fa.total_flights > 806 AND fa.avg_dep_delay > '0' ORDER BY fa.total_flights DESC, fa.avg_dep_delay DESC;

WITH ranked_flights AS ( SELECT f.year, f.month, f.dayofmonth, f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid, f.depdelayminutes, f.arrdelayminutes, f.distance, f.cancelled, f.diverted, f.carrierdelay, f.weatherdelay, f.nasdelay, f.securitydelay, f.lateaircraftdelay, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid ORDER BY f.depdelayminutes DESC) AS dep_delay_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.uniquecarrier, f.destairportid ORDER BY f.arrdelayminutes DESC) AS arr_delay_rank, SUM(f.flights) OVER (PARTITION BY f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid) AS total_flights_route, AVG(f.distance) OVER (PARTITION BY f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid) AS avg_distance_route FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f WHERE f.year = 2016 AND f.month BETWEEN 1 AND 2 ), carrier_metrics AS ( SELECT rf.uniquecarrier, rf.originairportid, rf.destairportid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, SUM(rf.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay, SUM(rf.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay, MAX(rf.depdelayminutes) AS max_dep_delay, MAX(rf.arrdelayminutes) AS max_arr_delay, AVG(rf.distance) AS avg_distance, SUM(rf.cancelled) AS cancelled_count, SUM(rf.diverted) AS diverted_count, SUM(rf.carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(rf.weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(rf.nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, SUM(rf.securitydelay) AS total_security_delay, SUM(rf.lateaircraftdelay) AS total_late_aircraft_delay, rf.total_flights_route, rf.avg_distance_route FROM ranked_flights rf WHERE rf.dep_delay_rank <= 31 OR rf.arr_delay_rank <= 7 GROUP BY rf.uniquecarrier, rf.originairportid, rf.destairportid, rf.total_flights_route, rf.avg_distance_route HAVING SUM(rf.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND SUM(rf.arrdelayminutes) > '0' ), airport_aggregates AS ( SELECT cm.uniquecarrier, cm.originairportid, cm.destairportid, cm.flight_count, cm.total_dep_delay, cm.total_arr_delay, cm.max_dep_delay, cm.max_arr_delay, cm.avg_distance, cm.cancelled_count, cm.diverted_count, cm.total_carrier_delay, cm.total_weather_delay, cm.total_nas_delay, cm.total_security_delay, cm.total_late_aircraft_delay, cm.total_flights_route, cm.avg_distance_route, lai.description AS airline_desc, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport_desc, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, lcmo.description AS origin_city_market_desc, lcmd.description AS dest_city_market_desc, lsao.description AS origin_state_desc, lsad.description AS dest_state_desc, ldg.description AS distance_group_desc, lq.description AS quarter_desc FROM carrier_metrics cm JOIN l_unique_carriers luc ON cm.uniquecarrier = luc.code JOIN l_airline_id lai ON cm.uniquecarrier = lai.code::character varying JOIN l_airport_id lap_origin ON cm.originairportid = lap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON cm.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcmo ON cm.originairportid = lcmo.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcmd ON cm.destairportid = lcmd.code JOIN l_state_fips lsfo ON cm.originairportid = lsfo.code JOIN l_state_fips lsfd ON cm.destairportid = lsfd.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation lsao ON lsfo.code = lsao.code::integer JOIN l_state_abr_aviation lsad ON lsfd.code = lsad.code::integer JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON cm.avg_distance_route::integer = ldg.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON (SELECT quarter FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE uniquecarrier = cm.uniquecarrier AND originairportid = cm.originairportid AND destairportid = cm.destairportid LIMIT 1) = lq.code WHERE cm.flight_count > 6631 AND cm.avg_distance BETWEEN '0' AND '0' ) SELECT aa.uniquecarrier, aa.airline_desc, aa.originairportid, aa.origin_airport_desc, aa.destairportid, aa.dest_airport_desc, aa.origin_city_market_desc, aa.dest_city_market_desc, aa.origin_state_desc, aa.dest_state_desc, aa.flight_count, aa.total_dep_delay, aa.total_arr_delay, aa.max_dep_delay, aa.max_arr_delay, aa.avg_distance, aa.cancelled_count, aa.diverted_count, aa.total_carrier_delay, aa.total_weather_delay, aa.total_nas_delay, aa.total_security_delay, aa.total_late_aircraft_delay, aa.total_flights_route, aa.avg_distance_route, aa.distance_group_desc, aa.quarter_desc, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY aa.total_dep_delay DESC) AS dep_delay_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY aa.total_arr_delay DESC) AS arr_delay_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY aa.flight_count DESC) AS flight_count_rank FROM airport_aggregates aa WHERE aa.cancelled_count < 722 AND aa.diverted_count < 621 ORDER BY aa.total_dep_delay DESC, aa.total_arr_delay DESC, aa.flight_count DESC LIMIT 394;

SELECT o.airlineid, l_airline.description AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_minutes FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id l_airline ON o.airlineid = l_airline.code WHERE o.airlineid IN ( SELECT airlineid FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE depdelayminutes > '0' GROUP BY airlineid HAVING COUNT(*) > 396 ) AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.airlineid, l_airline.description ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_minutes FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code WHERE o.airlineid IN (SELECT airlineid FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE depdelayminutes > '0' GROUP BY airlineid HAVING COUNT(*) > 41) AND o.month >= 9 GROUP BY o.airlineid, l_uc.description ORDER BY total_dep_delay_minutes DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_m.description AS month_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o INNER JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code INNER JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code LEFT JOIN l_airport_id l_ai_orig ON o.originairportid = l_ai_orig.code LEFT JOIN l_airport_id l_ai_dest ON o.destairportid = l_ai_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation l_c ON o.cancellationcode = l_c.code WHERE o.distancegroup BETWEEN 7 AND 11 AND o.dayofweek = 6 GROUP BY o.airlineid, l_uc.description, l_m.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND COUNT(*) > 309 ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_m.description AS month_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code JOIN l_airline_id l_ai ON o.airlineid = l_ai.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ori ON o.originairportid = l_ori.code JOIN l_airport_id l_dest ON o.destairportid = l_dest.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.distancegroup BETWEEN 8 AND 6 GROUP BY o.airlineid, l_uc.description, l_m.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND SUM(o.distance) > '1000' ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.flightdate) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.flightdate) AS month, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_airline_id l_ai ON o.airlineid = l_ai.code JOIN l_airport_id l_orig ON o.originairportid = l_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id l_dest ON o.destairportid = l_dest.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distancegroup >= 10 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.flightdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.flightdate) HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(o.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 WHERE o2.originairportid = o.originairportid AND o2.destairportid = o.destairportid AND o2.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o2.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o2.depdelay > 36.76 AND o2.arrdelay > 277.1 ) AND o.year = 2016 AND o.distancegroup >= 22 GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier HAVING COUNT(*) > 783 AND AVG(o.depdelay) > 105.8 ORDER BY total_distance DESC, avg_departure_delay DESC;

< '0' ORDER BY o.year, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, total_flights DESC;

cmid_orig.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation sabr_orig ON o.originstate = sabr_orig.code JOIN l_state_fips sfips_orig ON o.originstatefips = sfips_orig.code JOIN l_world_area_codes wac_orig ON o.originwac
