WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_minutes, SUM(o.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay_minutes, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_minutes, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.month = 4 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid ) SELECT l_airline_id.description AS airline_name, l_airport_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_airport_dest.description AS dest_airport, af.total_flights, af.total_dep_delay_minutes, af.avg_dep_delay_minutes, af.total_arr_delay_minutes, af.avg_arr_delay_minutes, af.total_distance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid ORDER BY af.total_distance DESC) AS distance_rank_per_airline FROM aggregated_flights af JOIN l_airline_id ON af.airlineid = l_airline_id.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_origin ON af.originairportid = l_airport_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_dest ON af.destairportid = l_airport_dest.code WHERE af.total_flights > 79 AND af.total_distance >= '1000' ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC, af.total_distance DESC;

WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.month >= 1 AND o.month <= 3 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid ) SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_ap_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_ap_dest.description AS dest_airport, af.total_flights, af.total_distance, af.avg_dep_delay, af.cancelled_flights, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank FROM aggregated_flights af JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON af.airlineid = l_uc.code::integer JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_origin ON af.originairportid = l_ap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_dest ON af.destairportid = l_ap_dest.code WHERE af.total_distance > '100' ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.month >= 9 AND o.month <= 2 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid ) SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_ap_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_ap_dest.description AS dest_airport, af.total_flights, af.total_distance, af.avg_dep_delay, af.cancelled_flights, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank FROM aggregated_flights af JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON af.airlineid = l_uc.code::integer JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_origin ON af.originairportid = l_ap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_dest ON af.destairportid = l_ap_dest.code WHERE af.total_distance > '100' ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH airline_performance AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.flightdate, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.distancegroup, o.depdelayminutes, o.arrdelayminutes, o.cancelled, o.diverted, o.carrierdelay, o.weatherdelay, o.nasdelay, o.securitydelay, o.lateaircraftdelay, o.flights, o.distance, la.description AS airline_name, lq.description AS quarter_desc, lm.description AS month_desc, ld.description AS delay_group_desc, CASE WHEN o.arrdelayminutes > '60' THEN 'SEVERE_DELAY' WHEN o.arrdelayminutes > '15' THEN 'MODERATE_DELAY' ELSE 'MINOR_DELAY' END AS delay_severity FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON o.quarter = lq.code JOIN l_months lm ON o.month = lm.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups ld ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = ld.code WHERE o.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-07-01' AND o.distancegroup >= 11 AND o.cancelled = 0 ), airport_aggregates AS ( SELECT ap.originairportid, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.destairportid) AS unique_destinations, SUM(ap.flights) AS total_flights, AVG(ap.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(ap.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(ap.carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(ap.weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(ap.nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ap.distance) AS median_distance, COUNT(CASE WHEN ap.delay_severity = 'SEVERE_DELAY' THEN 1 END) AS severe_delays FROM airline_performance ap GROUP BY ap.originairportid HAVING SUM(ap.flights) > '100' ), ranked_airlines AS ( SELECT ap.airlineid, ap.uniquecarrier, ap.airline_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.originairportid) AS airports_served, SUM(ap.flights) AS total_airline_flights, SUM(ap.distance * ap.flights) AS total_distance_weighted, AVG(ap.arrdelayminutes) AS overall_avg_delay, STDDEV(ap.arrdelayminutes) AS delay_stddev, CORR(ap.depdelayminutes, ap.arrdelayminutes) AS dep_arr_delay_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ap.flights) DESC) AS flight_volume_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ap.arrdelayminutes) ASC) AS punctuality_rank FROM airline_performance ap GROUP BY ap.airlineid, ap.uniquecarrier, ap.airline_name ), final_analysis AS ( SELECT ra.airlineid, ra.uniquecarrier, ra.airline_name, ra.airports_served, ra.total_airline_flights, ra.total_distance_weighted, ra.overall_avg_delay, ra.delay_stddev, ra.dep_arr_delay_correlation, ra.flight_volume_rank, ra.punctuality_rank, aa.unique_destinations, aa.total_flights AS origin_airport_flights, aa.avg_dep_delay, aa.avg_arr_delay, aa.total_carrier_delay, aa.total_weather_delay, aa.total_nas_delay, aa.median_distance, aa.severe_delays, lap.code AS origin_airport_code, lap.description AS origin_airport_name, lcs.code AS origin_city_market_id, lcs.description AS origin_city_name, lst.code AS origin_state_code, lst.description AS origin_state_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.airlineid ORDER BY aa.total_flights DESC) AS airport_rank_within_airline FROM ranked_airlines ra CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT DISTINCT ap.originairportid FROM airline_performance ap WHERE ap.airlineid = ra.airlineid ) airline_airports JOIN airport_aggregates aa ON airline_airports.originairportid = aa.originairportid JOIN l_airport_id lap ON airline_airports.originairportid = lap.code LEFT JOIN l_city_market_id lcs ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 WHERE o2.originairportid = airline_airports.originairportid AND o2.origincitymarketid = lcs.code LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN l_state_fips lst ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o3 WHERE o3.originairportid = airline_airports.originairportid AND o3.originstatefips = lst.code LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ra.flight_volume_rank <= 19 AND aa.severe_delays > 12 ) SELECT fa.airlineid, fa.uniquecarrier, fa.airline_name, fa.origin_airport_code, fa.origin_airport_name, fa.origin_city_name, fa.origin_state_name, fa.airports_served, fa.total_airline_flights, fa.total_distance_weighted, fa.overall_avg_delay, fa.delay_stddev, fa.dep_arr_delay_correlation, fa.flight_volume_rank, fa.punctuality_rank, fa.unique_destinations, fa.origin_airport_flights, fa.avg_dep_delay, fa.avg_arr_delay, fa.total_carrier_delay, fa.total_weather_delay, fa.total_nas_delay, fa.median_distance, fa.severe_delays, fa.airport_rank_within_airline, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.total_distance_weighted DESC) AS distance_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.overall_avg_delay DESC) AS worst_punctuality_rank, (fa.total_carrier_delay + fa.total_weather_delay + fa.total_nas_delay) / NULLIF(fa.origin_airport_flights, 0) AS avg_delay_minutes_per_flight FROM final_analysis fa WHERE fa.airport_rank_within_airline <= 3 AND fa.overall_avg_delay > '5' ORDER BY fa.flight_volume_rank, fa.airport_rank_within_airline, fa.severe_delays DESC LIMIT 405;

SELECT airlineid, flightnum, origin, dest, arrdelay, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY airlineid ORDER BY arrdelay DESC) AS delay_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE arrdelay IS NOT NULL AND airlineid = 19441 AND flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND flightdate <= '2016-01-01' ORDER BY airlineid, delay_rank;

SELECT airlineid, flightnum, origin, dest, depdelay, arrdelay, AVG(depdelay) OVER (PARTITION BY airlineid ORDER BY flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_delay_7day FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND airlineid = 19883 ORDER BY flightdate, flightnum;

SELECT f.uniquecarrier, SUM(f.depdelayminutes) AS total_depdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airline_id a ON f.airlineid = a.code WHERE f.month >= 7 AND f.dayofmonth <= 5 GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier HAVING SUM(f.depdelayminutes) > '0' INTERSECT SELECT f.uniquecarrier, SUM(f.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arrdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airport_id ap ON f.destairportid = ap.code WHERE f.distancegroup >= 10 AND f.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier HAVING SUM(f.arrdelayminutes) < '0' ORDER BY 1;

SELECT f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest, AVG(f.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airline_id la ON f.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport lo ON f.origin = lo.code JOIN l_airport ld ON f.dest = ld.code WHERE f.depdelayminutes > '0' AND f.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 93 INTERSECT SELECT f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest, AVG(f.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airline_id la ON f.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport lo ON f.origin = lo.code JOIN l_airport ld ON f.dest = ld.code WHERE f.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND f.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest HAVING COUNT(*) < 222 ORDER BY flight_count DESC;

SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_ap_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_ap_dest.description AS dest_airport, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.flightdate) AS flight_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.flightdate) AS flight_quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.flights) AS total_flight_segments, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_min, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_min, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(o.diverted) AS diverted_flights, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay, MAX(o.depdelayminutes) AS max_dep_delay, MAX(o.arrdelayminutes) AS max_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_origin ON o.originairportid = l_ap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_dest ON o.destairportid = l_ap_dest.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups l_odg_dep ON o.departuredelaygroups = l_odg_dep.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups l_odg_arr ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = l_odg_arr.code WHERE o.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND o.distancegroup >= 6 AND o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes > '0' GROUP BY l_uc.description, l_ap_origin.description, l_ap_dest.description, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.flightdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM o.flightdate) HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 AND AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '5' AND SUM(o.distance) > '1000' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay_min DESC LIMIT 1000;

l_airport_id l_ap_dest ON o.destairportid = l_ap_dest.code JOIN l_quarters l_q ON o.quarter = l_q.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code JOIN l_airline_id l_ai ON o.airlineid = l_ai.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_cm_origin ON o.origincitymarketid = l_cm_origin.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_cm_dest ON o.destcitymarketid = l_cm_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf_origin ON o.originstatefips = = l_wac_dest.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups l_odg_dep ON o.departuredelaygroups = l_odg_dep.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups l_odg_arr ON weighted_flights, AVG(f.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(f.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(f.depdel15) AS total_dep_delays, SUM(f.arrdel15) AS total_arr_delays, SUM(f.carrierdelay) AS DESC ) AS flight_rank, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.distancegroup, fm.cancelled ORDER BY fm.avg_dep_delay DESC ) AS delay_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.quarter, fm.diverted ORDER BY PARTITION BY fm.uniquecarrier ORDER BY fm.month ) AS next_month_dep_delay FROM flight_metrics fm JOIN l_unique_carriers la ON fm.uniquecarrier = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lair ON fm.originairportid = l_diversions ld ON fm.diverted = ld.code WHERE fm.total_flights >= 444 AND fm.weighted_flights > '0.1' AND fm.total_distance >= '100' ), aggregated_analysis AS ( SELECT cr.airline_name, cr.airport_origin_name, cr.airport_dest_name, cr.distance_group_desc, cr.cancellation_desc, cr.diversion_desc, cr.year, cr.quarter, cr.month, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.uniquecarrier) AS unique_carriers_count, SUM(cr.total_flights) AS grand_total_flights, SUM(cr.weighted_flights) AS grand_weighted_flights, AVG(cr.avg_dep_delay) AS overall_avg_dep_delay, AVG(cr.avg_arr_delay) AS overall_avg_arr_delay, SUM(cr.total_dep_delays) AS overall_dep_delays, SUM(cr.total_arr_delays) AS overall_arr_delays, SUM(cr.total_carrier_delay) AS overall_carrier_delay, SUM(cr.total_weather_delay) AS overall_weather_delay, SUM(cr.total_nas_delay) AS overall_nas_delay, SUM(cr.total_security_delay) AS overall_security_delay, SUM(cr.total_late_aircraft_delay) AS overall_late_aircraft_delay, SUM(cr.total_distance) AS overall_total_distance, MAX(cr.max_dep_delay) AS overall_max_dep_delay, MAX(cr.max_arr_delay) AS overall_max_arr_delay, AVG(cr.route_avg_delay) AS avg_route_delay, SUM(cr.carrier_quarter_total) AS carrier_quarter_aggregate, CORR(cr.total_flights, cr.avg_dep_delay) AS flights_delay_correlation, STDDEV(cr.avg_arr_delay) AS arr_delay_stddev FROM carrier_rankings cr WHERE cr.flight_rank <= 63 AND cr.delay_rank <= 10 AND cr.distance_rank >= 11 GROUP BY cr.airline_name, cr.airport_origin_name, cr.airport_dest_name, cr.distance_group_desc, cr.cancellation_desc, SELECT o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.depdel15, o.arrdel15, AVG(o.depdel15) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_dep_del15, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS recent_flights_on_route FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance > 2535.66 AND o.airlineid IN (SELECT code FROM l_airline_id WHERE code IN (20916, 20432)) AND o.originstatefips = 40 AND o.deststatefips = 21 ORDER BY o.flightdate DESC, o.airlineid;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE airlineid = o.airlineid AND cancelled = 1) AS cancelled_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lori ON o.originairportid = lori.code JOIN l_airport_id ldes ON o.destairportid = ldes.code WHERE o.month >= 7 AND o.month <= 3 AND o.distancegroup > 10 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_dep_delay_minutes DESC;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.arrdelay) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 17 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_arrdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-07-01' AND o.arrdelay IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier, AVG(o.depdel15) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_depdel15, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance > 383.27 AND o.airlineid = 19604 ORDER BY o.origin, o.dest, o.uniquecarrier, o.flightdate;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, MAX(o.distance) AS max_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 WHERE o2.originairportid = o.originairportid AND o2.destairportid = o.destairportid AND o2.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o2.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o2.depdelay > 289.61 ) AND o.quarter = 3 AND o.distancegroup = 22 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier HAVING AVG(o.arrdelay) > 105.31 ORDER BY flight_count DESC, avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.month, o.dayofmonth, o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_depdelay_7day, SUM(o.flights) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.uniquecarrier ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport lo ON o.origin = lo.code JOIN l_airport ld ON o.dest = ld.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON o.distancegroup = ldg.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY o.year, o.month, o.dayofmonth, o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.depdelayminutes, o.flights HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '10' ORDER BY o.flightdate, o.uniquecarrier;

SELECT o.year, o.month, o.dayofmonth, o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, SUM(o.flights) AS total_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(AVG(o.depdelayminutes)) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin ORDER BY o.year, o.month, o.dayofmonth ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_delay_7day FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON o.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_airport_id oa ON o.originairportid = oa.code JOIN l_airport_id da ON o.destairportid = da.code JOIN l_months m ON o.month = m.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.year = 2016 AND o.month BETWEEN 1 AND 8 GROUP BY o.year, o.month, o.dayofmonth, o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '10' ORDER BY o.year, o.month, o.dayofmonth, total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_flights, AVG(CASE WHEN o.depdelay IS NOT NULL THEN o.depdelay ELSE 0 END) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(CASE WHEN o.arrdelay IS NOT NULL THEN o.arrdelay ELSE 0 END) AS avg_arrival_delay, SUM(CASE WHEN o.carrierdelay > 0 THEN 1 WHEN o.weatherdelay > 0 THEN 1 WHEN o.nasdelay > 0 THEN 1 WHEN o.securitydelay > 0 THEN 1 WHEN o.lateaircraftdelay > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_flights_any_reason FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distancegroup >= 14 AND o.distancegroup <= 13 AND o.dayofweek IN (3, 1) GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, a.description HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2198 ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_desc, o.origin, loa.description AS origin_airport_desc, o.dest, lda.description AS dest_airport_desc, lq.description AS SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM l_airline_id la WHERE la.code = o.airlineid AND la.description ILIKE '%airline%' ) AND o.distancegroup BETWEEN 19 AND 12 AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, SUM(o.flights) AS total_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(AVG(o.depdelayminutes)) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.uniquecarrier, o.quarter ORDER BY o.month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_delay_3mo FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON o.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_quarters q ON o.quarter = q.code JOIN l_months m ON o.month = m.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.year = 2016 AND o.distancegroup >= 5 GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '5' ORDER BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.flights) AS total_flights_sum, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 WHERE o2.uniquecarrier = o.uniquecarrier AND o2.year = o.year AND o2.cancelled = 1) AS carrier_cancelled_year_count, (SELECT AVG(o3.depdelayminutes) FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o3 WHERE o3.origin = o.origin AND o3.depdelayminutes > '60') AS origin_avg_high_dep_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON o.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_airline_id aid ON o.airlineid = aid.code JOIN l_airport ap_orig ON o.origin = ap_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id apid_orig ON o.originairportid = apid_orig.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id apsid_orig ON o.originairportseqid = apsid_orig.code JOIN l_city_market_id cmid_orig ON o.origincitymarketid = cmid_orig.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation sabr_orig ON o.originstate = sabr_orig.code JOIN l_state_fips sfips_orig ON o.originstatefips = sfips_orig.code JOIN l_world_area_codes wac_orig ON o.originwac = wac_orig.code JOIN l_airport ap_dest ON o.dest = ap_dest.code JOIN l_airport_id apid_dest ON o.destairportid = apid_dest.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id apsid_dest ON o.destairportseqid = apsid_dest.code JOIN l_city_market_id cmid_dest ON o.destcitymarketid = cmid_dest.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation sabr_dest ON o.deststate = sabr_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips sfips_dest ON o.deststatefips = sfips_dest.code JOIN l_world_area_codes wac_dest ON o.destwac = wac_dest.code JOIN l_deparrblk depblk ON o.deptimeblk = depblk.code JOIN l_deparrblk arrblk ON o.arrtimeblk = arrblk.code JOIN l_cancellation canc ON o.cancellationcode = canc.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 dg ON o.distancegroup = dg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups depdg ON o.departuredelaygroups = depdg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups arrdg ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = arrdg.code JOIN l_yesno_resp yn_canc ON o.cancelled = yn_canc.code JOIN l_yesno_resp yn_div ON o.diverted = yn_div.code JOIN l_months m ON o.month = m.code JOIN l_weekdays wd ON o.dayofweek = wd.code JOIN l_quarters q ON o.quarter = q.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.month BETWEEN 4 AND 8 GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND COUNT(*) > 187 ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC;

SELECT o1.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_m.description AS month_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o1.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o1.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o1.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o1.distance) AS total_distance, CORR(o1.depdelayminutes, o2.depdelayminutes) AS dep_delay_correlation FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o1 JOIN on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 ON o1.uniquecarrier = o2.uniquecarrier AND o1.flightdate = o2.flightdate AND o1.origin = o2.dest AND o1.dest = o2.origin AND o1.flightnum < o2.flightnum JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o1.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o1.month = l_m.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ai_orig ON o1.originairportid = l_ai_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ai_dest ON o1.destairportid = l_ai_dest.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o1.distancegroup = l_dg.code WHERE o1.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND o1.distancegroup >= 6 AND o1.month IN (12) GROUP BY o1.uniquecarrier, l_uc.description, l_m.description, o1.month HAVING COUNT(*) > 74 AND AVG(o1.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC;

WITH flight_metrics AS ( SELECT f.year, f.quarter, f.month, f.dayofmonth, f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid, f.origincitymarketid, f.destcitymarketid, f.originstatefips, f.deststatefips, f.originwac, f.destwac, f.distancegroup, f.cancellationcode, f.diverted, f.depdelayminutes, f.arrdelayminutes, f.carrierdelay, f.weatherdelay, f.nasdelay, f.securitydelay, f.lateaircraftdelay, f.actualelapsedtime, f.airtime, f.taxiout, f.taxiin, f.flights, f.distance, f.divairportlandings, f.divreacheddest, f.divactualelapsedtime, f.divarrdelay, f.divdistance, CASE WHEN f.depdelayminutes > '60' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS severe_dep_delay, CASE WHEN f.arrdelayminutes > '60' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS severe_arr_delay, CASE WHEN f.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cancelled_flag, CASE WHEN f.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS diverted_flag FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f WHERE f.year = 2016 AND f.quarter = 2 AND f.distance >= '100' AND f.flights >= '1' ), carrier_aggregates AS ( SELECT fm.uniquecarrier, uc.description AS carrier_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(fm.severe_dep_delay) AS severe_dep_delays, SUM(fm.severe_arr_delay) AS severe_arr_delays, SUM(fm.cancelled_flag) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(fm.diverted_flag) AS diverted_flights, AVG(fm.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(fm.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(fm.carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(fm.weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(fm.nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, SUM(fm.securitydelay) AS total_security_delay, SUM(fm.lateaircraftdelay) AS total_late_aircraft_delay, AVG(fm.actualelapsedtime) AS avg_actual_elapsed_time, AVG(fm.airtime) AS avg_airtime, AVG(fm.taxiout) AS avg_taxiout, AVG(fm.taxiin) AS avg_taxiin, SUM(fm.flights) AS total_flight_count, SUM(fm.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(fm.divairportlandings) AS total_div_landings, SUM(fm.divreacheddest) AS total_div_reached_dest, AVG(fm.divactualelapsedtime) AS avg_div_actual_elapsed, AVG(fm.divarrdelay) AS avg_div_arr_delay, AVG(fm.divdistance) AS avg_div_distance FROM flight_metrics fm JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON fm.uniquecarrier = uc.code GROUP BY fm.uniquecarrier, uc.description ), airport_aggregates AS ( SELECT fm.originairportid AS airport_id, a.description AS airport_name, COUNT(*) AS origin_flights, SUM(fm.severe_dep_delay) AS origin_severe_dep_delays, SUM(fm.severe_arr_delay) AS origin_severe_arr_delays, SUM(fm.cancelled_flag) AS origin_cancelled, SUM(fm.diverted_flag) AS origin_diverted, AVG(fm.depdelayminutes) AS origin_avg_dep_delay, AVG(fm.taxiout) AS origin_avg_taxiout FROM flight_metrics fm JOIN l_airport_id a ON fm.originairportid = a.code GROUP BY fm.originairportid, a.description ), state_aggregates AS ( SELECT fm.originstatefips AS state_fips, s.description AS state_name, COUNT(*) AS state_origin_flights, SUM(fm.severe_dep_delay) AS state_severe_dep_delays, SUM(fm.severe_arr_delay) AS state_severe_arr_delays, SUM(fm.cancelled_flag) AS state_cancelled, SUM(fm.diverted_flag) AS state_diverted, AVG(fm.depdelayminutes) AS state_avg_dep_delay, AVG(fm.arrdelayminutes) AS state_avg_arr_delay FROM flight_metrics fm JOIN l_state_fips s ON fm.originstatefips = s.code GROUP BY fm.originstatefips, s.description ), distance_group_aggregates AS ( SELECT fm.distancegroup, dg.description AS distance_group_desc, COUNT(*) AS group_flights, AVG(fm.depdelayminutes) AS group_avg_dep_delay, AVG(fm.arrdelayminutes) AS group_avg_arr_delay, AVG(fm.actualelapsedtime) AS group_avg_elapsed_time, AVG(fm.airtime) AS group_avg_airtime, SUM(fm.severe_dep_delay) AS group_severe_dep_delays, SUM(fm.severe_arr_delay) AS group_severe_arr_delays FROM flight_metrics fm JOIN l_distance_group_250 dg ON fm.distancegroup = dg.code GROUP BY fm.distancegroup, dg.description ) SELECT COALESCE(ca.uniquecarrier, 'ALL_CARRIERS') AS carrier_code, COALESCE(ca.carrier_name, 'ALL_CARRIERS') AS carrier_name, COALESCE(aa.airport_id::text, 'ALL_AIRPORTS') AS airport_id, COALESCE(aa.airport_name, 'ALL_AIRPORTS') AS airport_name, COALESCE(sa.state_fips::text, 'ALL_STATES') AS state_fips, COALESCE(sa.state_name, 'ALL_STATES') AS state_name, COALESCE(dga.distancegroup::text, 'ALL_DISTANCE_GROUPS') AS distance_group, COALESCE(dga.distance_group_desc, 'ALL_DISTANCE_GROUPS') AS distance_group_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_observations, SUM(ca.total_flights) AS aggregated_flights, SUM(ca.severe_dep_delays) AS total_severe_dep_delays, SUM(ca.severe_arr_delays) AS total_severe_arr_delays, SUM(ca.cancelled_flights) AS total_cancelled, SUM(ca.diverted_flights) AS total_diverted, AVG(ca.avg_dep_delay) AS overall_avg_dep_delay, AVG(ca.avg_arr_delay) AS overall_avg_arr_delay, SUM(ca.total_carrier_delay) AS total_carrier_delay_minutes, SUM(ca.total_weather_delay) AS total_weather_delay_minutes, SUM(ca.total_nas_delay) AS total_nas_delay_minutes, SUM(ca.total_security_delay) AS total_security_delay_minutes, SUM(ca.total_late_aircraft_delay) AS total_late_aircraft_delay_minutes, AVG(aa.origin_avg_dep_delay) AS airport_avg_dep_delay, AVG(sa.state_avg_dep_delay) AS state_avg_dep_delay, AVG(dga.group_avg_dep_delay) AS distance_group_avg_dep_delay FROM carrier_aggregates ca FULL OUTER JOIN airport_aggregates aa ON 1=1 FULL OUTER JOIN state_aggregates sa ON 1=1 FULL OUTER JOIN distance_group_aggregates dga ON 1=1 WHERE ca.avg_dep_delay > '5' AND ca.avg_arr_delay > '5' AND aa.origin_avg_dep_delay > '5' AND sa.state_avg_dep_delay > '5' AND dga.group_avg_dep_delay > '5' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (ca.uniquecarrier, ca.carrier_name), (aa.airport_id, aa.airport_name), (sa.state_fips, sa.state_name), (dga.distancegroup, dga.distance_group_desc), (ca.uniquecarrier, ca.carrier_name, aa.airport_id, aa.airport_name), (ca.uniquecarrier, ca.carrier_name, sa.state_fips, sa.state_name), (ca.uniquecarrier, ca.carrier_name, dga.distancegroup, dga.distance_group_desc), (aa.airport_id, aa.airport_name, sa.state_fips, sa.state_name), (aa.airport_id, aa.airport_name, dga.distancegroup, dga.distance_group_desc), (sa.state_fips, sa.state_name, dga.distancegroup, dga.distance_group_desc), (ca.uniquecarrier, ca.carrier_name, aa.airport_id, aa.airport_name, sa.state_fips, sa.state_name, dga.distancegroup, dga.distance_group_desc) ) HAVING COUNT(*) > 29 ORDER BY total_severe_dep_delays DESC, overall_avg_dep_delay DESC LIMIT 999;

WITH ranked_flights AS ( SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.flightdate, o.uniquecarrier, o.airlineid, o.carrier, o.origin, o.origincityname, o.originstate, o.dest, o.destcityname, o.deststate, o.depdelayminutes, o.arrdelayminutes, o.cancelled, o.diverted, o.distance, o.distancegroup, o.carrierdelay, o.weatherdelay, o.nasdelay, o.securitydelay, o.lateaircraftdelay, la.description AS airline_desc, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport_desc, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, lc.description AS cancellation_desc, ld.description AS deptimeblk_desc, lm.description AS month_desc, lq.description AS quarter_desc, lw.description AS weekday_desc, ls_origin.description AS origin_state_desc, ls_dest.description AS dest_state_desc, SUM(o.flights) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.originstate, o.deststate ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.originstate ORDER BY o.flightdate) AS avg_depdelay_by_airline_origin, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.quarter ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes DESC) AS arrival_delay_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_origin ON o.originairportid = lap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON o.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_cancellation lc ON o.cancellationcode = lc.code JOIN l_deparrblk ld ON o.deptimeblk = ld.code JOIN l_months lm ON o.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON o.quarter = lq.code JOIN l_weekdays lw ON o.dayofweek = lw.code JOIN l_state_fips ls_origin ON o.originstatefips = ls_origin.code JOIN l_state_fips ls_dest ON o.deststatefips = ls_dest.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND o.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND o.distancegroup >= 8 AND o.cancelled = 0 AND o.diverted = 0 ) SELECT year, quarter, uniquecarrier, airline_desc, originstate, origin_state_desc, deststate, dest_state_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay, SUM(arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay, AVG(depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, MAX(cumulative_flights) AS max_cumulative_flights, AVG(avg_depdelay_by_airline_origin) AS overall_avg_depdelay, SUM(carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, SUM(securitydelay) AS total_security_delay, SUM(lateaircraftdelay) AS total_lateaircraft_delay FROM ranked_flights WHERE arrival_delay_rank <= 65 GROUP BY year, quarter, uniquecarrier, airline_desc, originstate, origin_state_desc, deststate, dest_state_desc HAVING AVG(depdelayminutes) > '0' AND SUM(arrdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_arr_delay DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC LIMIT 387;

SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_ap_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_ap_dest.description AS dest_airport, l_q.description AS quarter_desc, l_m.description AS month_desc, l_wd.description AS weekday_desc, l_dg.description AS distance_group_desc, l_c.description AS cancellation_reason, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.flights) AS total_flight_segments, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_min, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_min, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(o.diverted) AS diverted_flights, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_origin ON o.originairportid = l_ap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_dest ON o.destairportid = l_ap_dest.code JOIN l_quarters l_q ON o.quarter = l_q.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code JOIN l_weekdays l_wd ON o.dayofweek = l_wd.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation l_c ON o.cancellationcode = l_c.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND o.distancegroup >= 11 AND o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes > '0' GROUP BY l_uc.description, l_ap_origin.description, l_ap_dest.description, l_q.description, l_m.description, l_wd.description, l_dg.description, l_c.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 522 AND AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND SUM(o.cancelled) < 173 ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay_min DESC LIMIT 7713;

SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_m.description AS month_name, l_dg.description AS distance_group_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.actualelapsedtime) AS median_elapsed_time FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ai_orig ON o.originairportid = l_ai_orig.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id l_asi_orig ON o.originairportseqid = l_asi_orig.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_cmi_orig ON o.origincitymarketid = l_cmi_orig.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf_orig ON o.originstatefips = l_sf_orig.code JOIN l_world_area_codes l_wac_orig ON o.originwac = l_wac_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ai_dest ON o.destairportid = l_ai_dest.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id l_asi_dest ON o.destairportseqid = l_asi_dest.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_cmi_dest ON o.destcitymarketid = l_cmi_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf_dest ON o.deststatefips = l_sf_dest.code JOIN l_world_area_codes l_wac_dest ON o.destwac = l_wac_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation l_c ON o.cancellationcode = l_c.code LEFT JOIN l_deparrblk l_db_dept ON o.deptimeblk = l_db_dept.code LEFT JOIN l_deparrblk l_db_arr ON o.arrtimeblk = l_db_arr.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups l_odg_dept ON o.departuredelaygroups = l_odg_dept.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups l_odg_arr ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = l_odg_arr.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance >= '0' AND o.year IN ( SELECT DISTINCT year FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE month IN ( SELECT code FROM l_months WHERE code BETWEEN 8 AND 10 ) AND uniquecarrier IN ( SELECT code FROM l_unique_carriers WHERE description LIKE 'A%' ) ) GROUP BY l_uc.description, l_m.description, l_dg.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND SUM(o.distance) > '1000' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC LIMIT 353;

SELECT o.airlineid, l_airline.description AS airline_desc, l_airport_origin.description AS origin_airport_desc, l_airport_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, l_months.description AS month_desc, l_weekdays.description AS weekday_desc, l_distance_group_250.description AS distance_group_desc, l_ontime_delay_groups.description AS delay_group_desc, l_cancellation.description AS cancel_desc, l_state_abr_aviation.description AS origin_state_desc, l_state_fips.description AS dest_state_fips_desc, l_world_area_codes.description AS origin_wac_desc, l_yesno_resp.description AS diverted_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_min, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_min, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(o.airtime) AS total_airtime, SUM(o.carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(o.weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(o.nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, SUM(o.securitydelay) AS total_security_delay, SUM(o.lateaircraftdelay) AS total_late_aircraft_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay, MAX(o.distance) AS max_distance, MIN(o.distance) AS min_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id l_airline ON o.airlineid = l_airline.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_origin ON o.originairportid = l_airport_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_dest ON o.destairportid = l_airport_dest.code JOIN l_months ON o.month = l_months.code JOIN l_weekdays ON o.dayofweek = l_weekdays.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ON o.distancegroup = l_distance_group_250.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = l_ontime_delay_groups.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation ON o.cancellationcode = l_cancellation.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation ON o.originstate = l_state_abr_aviation.code JOIN l_state_fips ON o.deststatefips = l_state_fips.code JOIN l_world_area_codes ON o.originwac = l_world_area_codes.code JOIN l_yesno_resp ON o.diverted = l_yesno_resp.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance >= '0' AND o.distance <= '0' AND o.depdelayminutes >= '0' AND o.depdelayminutes <= '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes >= '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes <= '0' AND o.cancelled = 0 AND o.diverted = 0 GROUP BY o.airlineid, l_airline.description, l_airport_origin.description, l_airport_dest.description, l_months.description, l_weekdays.description, l_distance_group_250.description, l_ontime_delay_groups.description, l_cancellation.description, l_state_abr_aviation.description, l_state_fips.description, l_world_area_codes.description, l_yesno_resp.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 8938 AND AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay_min DESC LIMIT 423;

WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_minutes, SUM(o.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay_minutes, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_minutes, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.month >= 4 AND o.dayofmonth <= 21 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid ) SELECT l_airline_id.description AS airline_name, l_airport_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_airport_dest.description AS dest_airport, af.total_flights, af.total_dep_delay_minutes, af.avg_dep_delay_minutes, af.total_arr_delay_minutes, af.avg_arr_delay_minutes, af.total_distance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid ORDER BY af.total_distance DESC) AS distance_rank_per_airline FROM aggregated_flights af JOIN l_airline_id ON af.airlineid = l_airline_id.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_origin ON af.originairportid = l_airport_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_dest ON af.destairportid = l_airport_dest.code WHERE af.total_flights > 571 AND af.total_distance < '1000' ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC, af.total_distance DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_minutes, SUM(o.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay_minutes, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_minutes, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, AVG(o.distance) AS avg_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.month = 12 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid ) SELECT a.airlineid, a.uniquecarrier, l_airline.description AS airline_name, l_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_dest.description AS dest_airport, a.total_flights, a.total_dep_delay_minutes, a.avg_dep_delay_minutes, a.total_arr_delay_minutes, a.avg_arr_delay_minutes, a.total_distance, a.avg_distance FROM aggregated_flights a JOIN l_airline_id l_airline ON a.airlineid = l_airline.code JOIN l_airport_id l_origin ON a.originairportid = l_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_dest ON a.destairportid = l_dest.code WHERE a.total_flights > 557 AND a.avg_dep_delay_minutes > '0' ORDER BY a.total_flights DESC, a.avg_dep_delay_minutes DESC;

SELECT f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest, AVG(f.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airline_id la ON f.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport lo ON f.origin = lo.code JOIN l_airport ld ON f.dest = ld.code WHERE f.depdelayminutes > '0' AND f.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 15 INTERSECT SELECT f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest, AVG(f.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f JOIN l_airline_id la ON f.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport lo ON f.origin = lo.code JOIN l_airport ld ON f.dest = ld.code WHERE f.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND f.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY f.uniquecarrier, f.origin, f.dest HAVING COUNT(*) < 456 ORDER BY flight_count DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(o.distance) AS avg_distance, SUM(CASE WHEN o.depdelay > 30.11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_departures, SUM(CASE WHEN o.arrdelay > 347.72 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_arrivals, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.depdelay) AS median_depdelay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelay) AS median_arrdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distancegroup = 22 AND o.cancelled = 0 AND o.diverted = 0 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest HAVING COUNT(*) >= 278 AND AVG(o.distance) BETWEEN '50' AND '50' ORDER BY flight_count DESC, avg_distance DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_depdelay, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_depdelay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid ORDER BY SUM(o.depdelayminutes) DESC) AS delay_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lori ON o.originairportid = lori.code JOIN l_airport_id ldes ON o.destairportid = ldes.code JOIN l_months lm ON o.month = lm.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.month >= 4 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month HAVING COUNT(*) > 95 ORDER BY total_depdelay DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM l_airline_id a WHERE a.code = o.airlineid AND a.code = 16835 ) AND o.month = 8 AND o.distancegroup = 11 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, o.depdel15, o.arrdel15, AVG(o.depdel15) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_dep_del15, AVG(o.arrdel15) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_arr_del15 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.airlineid = 20373 AND o.distance > '100.0' ORDER BY o.flightdate, o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.airlineid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT airlineid FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE month IN ( SELECT code FROM l_months WHERE code BETWEEN 5 AND 11 ) AND originstatefips = 34 ) AND o.distancegroup >= 25 AND o.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest HAVING AVG(o.depdelay) > 44.82 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, flight_count DESC;

flight_duration_percentile_state_pair FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 f WHERE f.year = 2016 AND f.quarter BETWEEN 2 AND 1 AND f.distance >= '0' AND f.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND f.depdelayminutes <= '0' AND f.arrdelayminutes <= '0' ), airline_aggregates AS ( SELECT fm.airlineid, la.description AS airline_name, fm.quarter, fm.month, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(fm.flights) AS weighted_flights, AVG(fm.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(fm.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(fm.actual_dep_delay) AS total_actual_dep_delay, SUM(fm.actual_arr_delay) AS ap.uniquecarrier, ap.airline_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.originairportid) AS airports_served, SUM(ap.flights) AS total_airline_flights, SUM(ap.distance * ap.flights) AS total_distance_weighted, AVG(ap.arrdelayminutes) AS overall_avg_delay, STDDEV(ap.arrdelayminutes) AS delay_stddev, CORR(ap.depdelayminutes, ap.arrdelayminutes) AS dep_arr_delay_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ap.airline_name ), final_analysis AS ( SELECT ra.airlineid, ra.uniquecarrier, ra.airline_name, ra.airports_served, ra.total_airline_flights, ra.total_distance_weighted, ra.overall_avg_delay, ra.delay_stddev, ra.dep_arr_delay_correlation, ra.flight_volume_rank, ra.punctuality_rank, aa.unique_destinations, aa.total_flights AS origin_airport_flights, aa.avg_dep_delay, aa.avg_arr_delay, DESC) AS airport_rank_within_airline FROM ranked_airlines ra CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT DISTINCT ap.originairportid FROM airline_performance ap WHERE ap.airlineid = ra.airlineid ) airline_airports SELECT 1 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o3 WHERE o3.originairportid = airline_airports.originairportid AND o3.originstatefips = lst.code LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ra.flight_volume_rank <= 9 AND RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.total_distance_weighted DESC) AS distance_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fa.overall_avg_delay DESC) AS worst_punctuality_rank, (fa.total_carrier_delay + fa.total_weather_delay + SELECT o1.uniquecarrier, o1.origin, o2.dest, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, AVG(o1.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o2.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o1.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(o1.flights) AS total_flight_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o1.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o2.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay, CORR(o1.depdelayminutes, o2.arrdelayminutes) AS delay_correlation FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o1 JOIN on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 ON o1.uniquecarrier = o2.uniquecarrier AND o1.flightdate = o2.flightdate AND o1.originairportid = o2.destairportid AND o1.destairportid = o2.originairportid AND o1.flightnum = o2.flightnum JOIN l_airline_id lai ON o1.airlineid = lai.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_orig ON o1.originairportid = lap_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON o1.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcm_orig ON o1.origincitymarketid = lcm_orig.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcm_dest ON o1.destcitymarketid = lcm_dest.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON o1.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_dep ON o1.departuredelaygroups = lodg_dep.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_arr ON o2.arrivaldelaygroups = lodg_arr.code JOIN l_weekdays lw ON o1.dayofweek = lw.code JOIN l_months lm ON o1.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON o1.quarter = lq.code WHERE o1.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o2.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND o1.distancegroup BETWEEN 4 AND 3 AND o1.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' AND o1.cancelled = 0 AND o2.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY o1.uniquecarrier, o1.origin, o2.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 518 AND AVG(o1.depdelayminutes) > '5' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT l_airline_id.code AS airline_code, l_airline_id.description AS airline_name, l_airport_id.code AS airport_code, l_airport_id.description AS airport_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.flights) AS total_flight_count, AVG(on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.depdelayminutes) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arrival_delay, SUM(on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.diverted) AS total_diverted FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 JOIN l_airline_id ON on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.airlineid = l_airline_id.code JOIN l_airport_id ON on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.originairportid = l_airport_id.code WHERE on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.depdelayminutes > '0' AND on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.arrdelayminutes > '0' AND on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY l_airline_id.code, l_airline_id.description, l_airport_id.code, l_airport_id.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 267 ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport_id orig ON o.originairportid = orig.code JOIN l_airport_id dest ON o.destairportid = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.depdelay > 121.57 AND orig.code IN (SELECT code FROM l_airport_id WHERE code BETWEEN 12789 AND 14272) AND dest.code IN (SELECT code FROM l_airport_id WHERE code BETWEEN 14456 AND 13162) GROUP BY o.airlineid, a.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 2734 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code WHERE o.airlineid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT airlineid FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE depdelayminutes > '0' AND month >= 10 ) GROUP BY o.airlineid, l_uc.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY avg_dep_delay DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(o.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, MAX(o.actualelapsedtime) AS max_elapsed_time FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code JOIN l_months m ON o.month = m.code JOIN l_weekdays w ON o.dayofweek = w.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.depdelay > 156.96 AND o.arrdelay > 41.86 AND o.distancegroup = 8 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 644 AND AVG(o.depdelay) > 71.34 AND AVG(o.arrdelay) > 81.02 ORDER BY total_distance DESC, avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.depdel15, o.arrdel15, AVG(o.depdelay) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_dep_delay, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS recent_dest_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance > '100.0' AND o.airlineid IN (SELECT code FROM l_airline_id WHERE code IN (19075, 19033)) AND o.cancelled = 0 AND o.diverted = 0 ORDER BY o.flightdate DESC, o.airlineid;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, o.depdel15, o.arrdel15, AVG(o.depdel15) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_dep_del15, AVG(o.arrdel15) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_arr_del15 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.airlineid = 19378 AND o.distance > '100.0' ORDER BY o.flightdate, o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_desc, o.origin, loa.description AS origin_airport_desc, o.dest, lda.description AS dest_airport_desc, SUM(o.flights) AS total_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, AVG(SUM(o.flights)) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest ORDER BY o.year, o.month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_flights_3mo, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY o.year, o.quarter ORDER BY SUM(o.flights) DESC ) AS flight_rank_by_qtr FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport loa ON o.origin = loa.code JOIN l_airport lda ON o.dest = lda.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcmi ON o.origincitymarketid = lcmi.code JOIN l_state_fips lsf ON o.originstatefips = lsf.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation lsaa ON o.originstate = lsaa.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON o.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_weekdays lw ON o.dayofweek = lw.code JOIN l_months lm ON o.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON o.quarter = lq.code JOIN l_yesno_resp lyn ON o.cancelled = lyn.code JOIN l_yesno_resp lyn2 ON o.diverted = lyn2.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON o.cancellationcode = lc.code LEFT JOIN l_deparrblk ldb ON o.deptimeblk = ldb.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg ON o.departuredelaygroups = lodg.code WHERE o.year >= 2015 AND o.month BETWEEN 3 AND 7 AND o.distancegroup >= 3 AND o.depdelayminutes > '0.0' GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, la.description, o.origin, loa.description, o.dest, lda.description HAVING SUM(o.flights) > '10.0' AND AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) < '0.0' ORDER BY o.year DESC, o.quarter DESC, total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_ap_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_ap_dest.description AS dest_airport, l_st_origin.description AS origin_state, l_st_dest.description AS dest_state, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(o.diverted) AS diverted_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o INNER JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code INNER JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_id_origin ON o.originairportid = l_ap_id_origin.code INNER JOIN l_airport l_ap_origin ON o.origin = l_ap_origin.code LEFT JOIN l_state_abr_aviation l_st_origin ON o.originstate = l_st_origin.code INNER JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_id_dest ON o.destairportid = l_ap_id_dest.code INNER JOIN l_airport l_ap_dest ON o.dest = l_ap_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_state_abr_aviation l_st_dest ON o.deststate = l_st_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation l_canc ON o.cancellationcode = l_canc.code LEFT JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dist ON o.distancegroup = l_dist.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance >= '0' AND o.month IN (1, 3, 2) GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, l_uc.description, l_ap_origin.description, l_ap_dest.description, l_st_origin.description, l_st_dest.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND COUNT(*) > 87 ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC;

WITH flight_agg AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdel15) AS total_dep_delays, SUM(o.arrdel15) AS total_arr_delays, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter ) SELECT la.description AS airline_name, lap_orig.description AS origin_airport, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport, lm.description AS month_name, lq.description AS quarter_name, fa.total_flights, fa.total_dep_delays, fa.total_arr_delays, fa.avg_dep_delay, fa.avg_arr_delay, fa.total_cancelled, fa.total_diverted, fa.total_distance, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fa.airlineid ORDER BY fa.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank_per_airline, SUM(fa.total_flights) OVER (PARTITION BY fa.airlineid, fa.quarter) AS airline_quarterly_flights FROM flight_agg fa JOIN l_airline_id la ON fa.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_orig ON fa.originairportid = lap_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON fa.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_months lm ON fa.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON fa.quarter = lq.code WHERE fa.total_flights > 298 AND fa.avg_dep_delay > '0' ORDER BY fa.total_flights DESC, fa.avg_dep_delay DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS total_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.depdelay IS NOT NULL AND o.distancegroup = 20 GROUP BY o.airlineid, a.description ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelay) AS median_arrival_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code JOIN l_state_fips orig_state ON o.originstatefips = orig_state.code JOIN l_state_fips dest_state ON o.deststatefips = dest_state.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance > 3370.64 AND o.airlineid IN (SELECT code FROM l_airline_id WHERE code IN (20932, 19471)) GROUP BY o.airlineid, a.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 201 AND AVG(o.depdelay) > 80.91 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.depdelay > 43.39 AND o.distancegroup = 22 GROUP BY o.airlineid, a.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 803 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE airlineid = o.airlineid AND cancelled = 1) AS cancelled_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lori ON o.originairportid = lori.code JOIN l_airport_id ldes ON o.destairportid = ldes.code WHERE o.month >= 1 AND o.month <= 3 AND o.distancegroup > 4 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_dep_delay_minutes DESC;

SELECT o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.depdelay IS NOT NULL AND ( (o.month = 10 AND o.dayofweek = 2) OR (o.distance > '100' AND o.diverted = 1) ) AND NOT (o.cancelled = 1) GROUP BY o.origin, o.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.uniquecarrier, o.depdel15, o.arrdel15 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airport a1 ON o.origin = a1.code JOIN l_airport a2 ON o.dest = a2.code JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON o.uniquecarrier = uc.code WHERE o.month = 9 AND o.distancegroup = 18 AND o.depdel15 = 1 AND o.arrdel15 = 0 AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' INTERSECT SELECT o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.uniquecarrier, o.depdel15, o.arrdel15 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airport a1 ON o.origin = a1.code JOIN l_airport a2 ON o.dest = a2.code JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON o.uniquecarrier = uc.code WHERE o.quarter = 2 AND o.dayofweek = 4 AND o.diverted = 1 AND o.cancelled = 1 AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01';

ON oto.deststatefips = lsf_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_state_abr_aviation lsaa_origin ON oto.originstate = lsaa_origin.code LEFT JOIN l_state_abr_aviation lsaa_dest ON oto.deststate = lsaa_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_world_area_codes lwac_origin ON oto.originwac = lwac_origin.code LEFT JOIN l_world_area_codes lwac_dest ON oto.destwac = lwac_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_dep ON SELECT oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, oto.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_desc, oto.origin, lap_orig.description AS origin_airport_desc, oto.dest, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, ls_orig.description AS origin_state_desc, ls_dest.description AS dest_state_desc, SUM(oto.flights) AS total_flights, SUM(oto.distance) AS total_distance, AVG(oto.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(oto.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(CASE WHEN oto.cancelled = 1 THEN oto.flights ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN oto.diverted = 1 THEN oto.flights ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_flights, AVG(oto.airtime) AS avg_airtime, SUM(oto.carrierdelay + oto.weatherdelay + oto.nasdelay + oto.securitydelay + oto.lateaircraftdelay) AS total_delay_minutes, AVG(SUM(oto.flights)) OVER (PARTITION BY oto.uniquecarrier, oto.origin, oto.dest ORDER BY oto.year, oto.month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_flights_3mo FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 oto JOIN l_airline_id la ON oto.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_orig ON oto.originairportid = lap_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON oto.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips ls_orig ON oto.originstatefips = ls_orig.code JOIN l_state_fips ls_dest ON oto.deststatefips = ls_dest.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON oto.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_dep ON oto.departuredelaygroups = lodg_dep.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_arr ON oto.arrivaldelaygroups = lodg_arr.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON oto.cancellationcode = lc.code WHERE oto.year >= 2016 AND oto.month BETWEEN 7 AND 1 AND oto.distancegroup >= 11 AND oto.depdelayminutes > '0' GROUP BY oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, oto.uniquecarrier, la.description, oto.origin, lap_orig.description, oto.dest, lap_dest.description, ls_orig.description, ls_dest.description HAVING SUM(oto.flights) > '1' AND AVG(oto.arrdelayminutes) < '0' ORDER BY oto.year, oto.month, total_flights DESC;

SELECT sub.airlineid, sub.origincitymarketid, sub.destcitymarketid, sub.total_flights, sub.avg_depdelay FROM ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.origincitymarketid, o.destcitymarketid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_depdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcm_orig ON o.origincitymarketid = lcm_orig.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcm_dest ON o.destcitymarketid = lcm_dest.code WHERE o.depdelay > 437.63 AND o.distance > '0' GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.origincitymarketid, o.destcitymarketid HAVING COUNT(*) > 28 INTERSECT SELECT o.airlineid, o.origincitymarketid, o.destcitymarketid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, AVG(o.arrdelay) AS avg_depdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcm_orig ON o.origincitymarketid = lcm_orig.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcm_dest ON o.destcitymarketid = lcm_dest.code WHERE o.arrdelay < -5.71 AND o.distance < '100' GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.origincitymarketid, o.destcitymarketid HAVING AVG(o.arrdelay) < 9.52 ) sub ORDER BY sub.total_flights DESC;

WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, SUM(o.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay_minutes, AVG(o.distance) AS avg_distance, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes > '0' GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.uniquecarrier, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, o.month, o.quarter HAVING COUNT(*) > 617 AND AVG(o.distance) > '0' ) SELECT af.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_description, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport_desc, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, lm.description AS month_desc, lq.description AS quarter_desc, af.total_flights, af.total_dep_delay_minutes, af.total_arr_delay_minutes, af.avg_distance, af.total_cancelled, af.total_diverted, af.median_dep_delay, af.median_arr_delay, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank_per_airline, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY af.total_dep_delay_minutes DESC) AS dep_delay_rank, SUM(af.total_flights) OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid, af.quarter) AS airline_quarterly_flights, LAG(af.total_flights, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid, af.originairportid, af.destairportid ORDER BY af.month) AS prev_month_flights FROM JOIN l_months lm ON af.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON af.quarter = lq.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON af.total_cancelled > 0 AND lc.code = 'A' LEFT JOIN l_diversions ld ON af.total_diverted > 0 AND ld.code = 1 WHERE af.total_cancelled < 30 AND af.total_diverted < 18 ORDER BY af.total_dep_delay_minutes DESC, af.total_flights DESC LIMIT 2504;

f.arrdelayminutes, f.carrierdelay, f.weatherdelay, f.nasdelay, f.securitydelay, f.lateaircraftdelay, f.flights, f.distance, la.description AS airline_name, lap_orig.description AS origin_airport_name, SELECT o.airlineid, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_m.description AS month_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o INNER JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code INNER JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code LEFT JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_orig ON o.originairportid = l_ap_orig.code LEFT JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_dest ON o.destairportid = l_ap_dest.code WHERE o.distancegroup BETWEEN 8 AND 8 AND o.dayofweek = 1 GROUP BY o.airlineid, l_uc.description, l_m.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND COUNT(*) > 545 ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_m.description AS month_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code JOIN l_airline_id l_ai ON o.airlineid = l_ai.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ori ON o.originairportid = l_ori.code JOIN l_airport_id l_dest ON o.destairportid = l_dest.code WHERE o.distancegroup BETWEEN 3 AND 8 AND o.dayofweek IN (6, 5) AND o.crsdeptime >= 1260 AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.airlineid, l_uc.description, l_m.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND COUNT(*) > 164 ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.arrdelay) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_arrdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-07-01' AND o.arrdelay IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate;

SELECT oto.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_desc, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport_desc, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, lc.description AS cancellation_desc, ldg.description AS distance_group_desc, lq.description AS quarter_desc, lm.description AS month_desc, lw.description AS weekday_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(oto.flights) AS sum_flights, AVG(oto.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(oto.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(oto.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(oto.diverted) AS total_diverted, SUM(oto.distance) AS total_distance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY oto.airtime) AS median_airtime, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oto.flights) DESC) AS flight_rank FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 oto JOIN l_airline_id la ON oto.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_origin ON oto.originairportid = lap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON oto.destairportid = lap_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON oto.cancellationcode = lc.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON oto.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON oto.quarter = lq.code JOIN l_months lm ON oto.month = lm.code JOIN l_weekdays lw ON oto.dayofweek = lw.code LEFT JOIN l_yesno_resp lyn_c ON oto.cancelled = lyn_c.code LEFT JOIN l_yesno_resp lyn_d ON oto.diverted = lyn_d.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_dep ON oto.departuredelaygroups = lodg_dep.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_arr ON oto.arrivaldelaygroups = lodg_arr.code WHERE oto.year = 2016 AND oto.distance >= '0' AND oto.depdelayminutes > '0' AND oto.flightdate BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-01' GROUP BY oto.uniquecarrier, la.description, lap_origin.description, lap_dest.description, lc.description, ldg.description, lq.description, lm.description, lw.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 393 AND AVG(oto.arrdelayminutes) < '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay ASC LIMIT 50;

WITH ranked_flights AS ( SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.flightdate, o.uniquecarrier, o.airlineid, o.carrier, o.origin, o.origincityname, o.originstate, o.dest, o.destcityname, o.deststate, o.depdelayminutes, o.arrdelayminutes, o.cancelled, o.diverted, o.distance, o.distancegroup, o.carrierdelay, o.weatherdelay, o.nasdelay, o.securitydelay, o.lateaircraftdelay, la.description AS airline_desc, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport_desc, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, lc.description AS cancellation_desc, ld.description AS deptimeblk_desc, lm.description AS lap_dest.code JOIN l_cancellation lc ON o.cancellationcode = lc.code JOIN l_deparrblk ld ON o.deptimeblk = ld.code JOIN l_months lm ON o.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON o.quarter = lq.code JOIN l_weekdays lw ON o.dayofweek = lw.code JOIN l_state_fips ls_origin ON o.originstatefips = ls_origin.code JOIN l_state_fips ls_dest ON o.deststatefips = ls_dest.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND SELECT o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS total_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_months m ON o.month = m.code JOIN l_quarters q ON o.quarter = q.code WHERE o.depdelay IS NOT NULL AND o.month = 11 AND o.quarter = 1 AND o.distance > '50.0' GROUP BY o.airlineid, a.description ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;
