SELECT o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.depdel15, o.arrdel15, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_flights, AVG(o.depdel15) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_dep_del15, AVG(o.arrdel15) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_arr_del15 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.airlineid = 19503 AND o.distance > '100.0' ORDER BY o.airlineid, o.origin, o.flightdate;

SELECT o.originstate, o.deststate, COUNT(DISTINCT o.uniquecarrier) AS unique_carriers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.originairportid) AS unique_origin_airports, COUNT(DISTINCT o.destairportid) AS unique_dest_airports, SUM(o.flights) AS total_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON o.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation sa_orig ON o.originstate = sa_orig.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation sa_dest ON o.deststate = sa_dest.code WHERE o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.originstate, o.deststate HAVING SUM(o.flights) > '100' ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.airlineid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT airlineid FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE originstatefips IN ( SELECT code FROM l_state_fips WHERE code BETWEEN 45 AND 21 ) AND flightdate >= '2016-01-01' ) AND o.distancegroup = 12 AND o.quarter = 1 GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest HAVING AVG(o.depdelay) > 161.93 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_desc, o.origin, loa.description AS origin_airport_desc, o.dest, lda.description AS dest_airport_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.flights) AS sum_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport loa ON o.origin = loa.code JOIN l_airport lda ON o.dest = lda.code JOIN l_airport_id loai ON o.originairportid = loai.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id loasi ON o.originairportseqid = loasi.code JOIN l_airport_id ldai ON o.destairportid = ldai.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id ldasi ON o.destairportseqid = ldasi.code JOIN l_city_market_id locmi ON o.origincitymarketid = locmi.code JOIN l_city_market_id ldcmi ON o.destcitymarketid = ldcmi.code JOIN l_state_fips losf ON o.originstatefips = losf.code JOIN l_state_fips ldsf ON o.deststatefips = ldsf.code JOIN l_world_area_codes lowac ON o.originwac = lowac.code JOIN l_world_area_codes ldwac ON o.destwac = ldwac.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON o.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg ON o.departuredelaygroups = lodg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups ladg ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = ladg.code JOIN l_deparrblk lodtb ON o.deptimeblk = lodtb.code JOIN l_deparrblk ladtb ON o.arrtimeblk = ladtb.code JOIN l_weekdays lwd ON o.dayofweek = lwd.code JOIN l_months lm ON o.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON o.quarter = lq.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance >= '100' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 WHERE o2.uniquecarrier = o.uniquecarrier AND o2.origin = o.origin AND o2.dest = o.dest AND o2.flightdate BETWEEN o.flightdate - INTERVAL '30 days' AND o.flightdate + INTERVAL '30 days' AND o2.arrdelayminutes > '30' ) GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, la.description, o.origin, loa.description, o.dest, lda.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '10' AND COUNT(*) > 22 ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_arr_delay DESC;

WITH aggregated_flights AS ( SELECT o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.depdelayminutes) AS total_dep_delay_minutes, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_minutes, SUM(o.arrdelayminutes) AS total_arr_delay_minutes, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_minutes, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.month >= 11 AND o.dayofmonth <= 28 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.originairportid, o.destairportid ) SELECT l_airline_id.description AS airline_name, l_airport_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_airport_dest.description AS dest_airport, af.total_flights, af.total_dep_delay_minutes, af.avg_dep_delay_minutes, af.total_arr_delay_minutes, af.avg_arr_delay_minutes, af.total_distance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY af.airlineid ORDER BY af.total_distance DESC) AS distance_rank_per_airline FROM aggregated_flights af JOIN l_airline_id ON af.airlineid = l_airline_id.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_origin ON af.originairportid = l_airport_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_dest ON af.destairportid = l_airport_dest.code WHERE af.total_flights > 102 AND af.total_distance < '1000' ORDER BY af.total_flights DESC, af.total_distance DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH flight_metrics AS ( SELECT f.year, f.quarter, f.month, f.uniquecarrier, f.originairportid, f.destairportid, f.distancegroup, f.cancelled, f.diverted, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(f.flights) AS f.distancegroup, f.cancelled, f.diverted ), carrier_rankings AS ( SELECT fm.*, la.description AS airline_name, lair.description AS airport_origin_name, laird.description AS airport_dest_name, fm.total_distance DESC ) AS distance_rank, SUM(fm.total_flights) OVER ( PARTITION BY fm.uniquecarrier, fm.year, fm.quarter ) AS carrier_quarter_total, AVG(fm.avg_arr_delay) OVER ( PARTITION BY PARTITION BY fm.uniquecarrier ORDER BY fm.month ) AS next_month_dep_delay FROM flight_metrics fm JOIN l_unique_carriers la ON fm.uniquecarrier = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lair ON fm.originairportid = overall_weather_delay, SUM(cr.total_nas_delay) AS overall_nas_delay, SUM(cr.total_security_delay) AS overall_security_delay, SUM(cr.total_late_aircraft_delay) AS overall_late_aircraft_delay, WHERE cr.flight_rank <= 93 AND cr.delay_rank <= 10 AND cr.distance_rank >= 38 GROUP BY cr.airline_name, cr.airport_origin_name, cr.airport_dest_name, cr.distance_group_desc, cr.cancellation_desc, cr.diversion_desc, cr.year, cr.quarter, cr.month HAVING SUM(cr.total_flights) >= 2760 AND AVG(cr.avg_dep_delay) <= '0' AND SUM(cr.total_distance) >= '1000' ) SELECT aa.*, lm.description AS month_name, lq.description AS quarter_name, lw.description AS weekday_avg_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY aa.airline_name, aa.quarter ORDER BY aa.grand_total_flights DESC ) AS airline_quarter_rank, RANK() SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_ap.description AS origin_state, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.flightdate) AS month_num, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation l_ap ON o.originstate = l_ap.code WHERE o.distancegroup BETWEEN 4 AND 9 AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY l_uc.description, l_ap.description, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.flightdate) HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND COUNT(*) >= 309 ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC;

SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_m.description AS month_name, l_dg.description AS distance_group_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code WHERE o.distance > '0' AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY l_uc.description, l_m.description, l_dg.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(o.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code JOIN l_months m ON o.month = m.code JOIN l_quarters q ON o.quarter = q.code WHERE o.depdelay > 268.87 AND o.arrdelay > 158.62 AND o.distance BETWEEN '50' AND '501' AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-07-01' AND o.dayofweek IN (2, 6) AND o.cancelled = 1 AND o.diverted = 1 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 457 AND AVG(o.depdelay) > 1.26 AND AVG(o.arrdelay) > 69.74 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, avg_arrival_delay DESC;

SELECT o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.quarter = 1 AND o.month = 9 AND o.dayofweek = 1 AND o.distancegroup = 19 GROUP BY o.origin, o.dest HAVING COUNT(*) >= 74 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC;

SELECT o.originstate, o.deststate, COUNT(DISTINCT o.uniquecarrier) AS unique_carriers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.originairportid) AS unique_origin_airports, COUNT(DISTINCT o.destairportid) AS unique_dest_airports, SUM(o.flights) AS total_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON o.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation sa_orig ON o.originstate = sa_orig.code JOIN l_state_abr_aviation sa_dest ON o.deststate = sa_dest.code WHERE o.distancegroup >= 10 AND o.month <= 11 GROUP BY o.originstate, o.deststate HAVING SUM(o.flights) > '50' ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_name, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport, ls_origin.description AS origin_state, ls_dest.description AS dest_state, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.flights) AS sum_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_count, SUM(o.diverted) AS diverted_count, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_origin ON o.originairportid = lap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON o.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips ls_origin ON o.originstatefips = ls_origin.code JOIN l_state_fips ls_dest ON o.deststatefips = ls_dest.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON o.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_weekdays lw ON o.dayofweek = lw.code JOIN l_months lm ON o.month = lm.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.quarter = 2 AND o.distancegroup >= 8 AND o.depdelayminutes > '0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o2 WHERE o2.uniquecarrier = o.uniquecarrier AND o2.year = o.year AND o2.month = o.month AND o2.cancelled = 1 AND o2.cancellationcode IS NOT NULL ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM l_airport la2 WHERE la2.code = o.origin AND la2.description LIKE '%International%' ) GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, la.description, lap_origin.description, lap_dest.description, ls_origin.description, ls_dest.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 497 AND AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) < '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC LIMIT 1000;

( SELECT fm.originstatefips AS state_fips, s.description AS state_name, COUNT(*) AS state_origin_flights, SUM(fm.severe_dep_delay) AS state_severe_dep_delays, SUM(fm.severe_arr_delay) AS l_distance_group_250 dg ON fm.distancegroup = dg.code GROUP BY fm.distancegroup, dg.description ) SELECT COALESCE(ca.uniquecarrier, 'ALL_CARRIERS') AS carrier_code, COALESCE(ca.carrier_name, total_severe_arr_delays, SUM(ca.cancelled_flights) AS total_cancelled, SUM(ca.diverted_flights) AS total_diverted, AVG(ca.avg_dep_delay) AS overall_avg_dep_delay, AVG(ca.avg_arr_delay) AS overall_avg_arr_delay, SUM(ca.total_carrier_delay) AS total_carrier_delay_minutes, SUM(ca.total_weather_delay) AS total_weather_delay_minutes, SUM(ca.total_nas_delay) AS total_nas_delay_minutes, dga.distance_group_desc), (ca.uniquecarrier, ca.carrier_name, aa.airport_id, aa.airport_name), (ca.uniquecarrier, ca.carrier_name, sa.state_fips, sa.state_name), (ca.uniquecarrier, ca.carrier_name, dga.distancegroup, dga.distance_group_desc), (aa.airport_id, aa.airport_name, sa.state_fips, sa.state_name), (aa.airport_id, aa.airport_name, dga.distancegroup, dga.distance_group_desc), SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.airlineid, a.description AS airline_name, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightnum, o.depdelay, o.arrdelay, AVG(o.depdelay) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.origin ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_dep_delay, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid, o.quarter ORDER BY o.arrdelay DESC) AS arrdelay_rank_in_quarter FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.depdelay > 206.9 AND o.arrdelay > 82.93 AND o.distancegroup = 14 ORDER BY o.airlineid, o.quarter, arrdelay_rank_in_quarter;

SELECT carrier_stats.carrier, carrier_stats.total_flights, carrier_stats.avg_dep_delay, carrier_stats.avg_arr_delay, carrier_stats.cancellation_rate, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY carrier_stats.total_flights DESC) AS flight_rank, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY carrier_stats.avg_arr_delay) AS punctuality_rank FROM ( SELECT o.uniquecarrier AS carrier, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, (SUM(o.cancelled) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS cancellation_rate FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers uc ON o.uniquecarrier = uc.code JOIN l_airline_id aid ON o.airlineid = aid.code JOIN l_airport_id oaid ON o.originairportid = oaid.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id oasid ON o.originairportseqid = oasid.code JOIN l_city_market_id ocid ON o.origincitymarketid = ocid.code JOIN l_state_fips osf ON o.originstatefips = osf.code JOIN l_world_area_codes owac ON o.originwac = owac.code JOIN l_airport_id daid ON o.destairportid = daid.code JOIN l_airport_seq_id dasid ON o.destairportseqid = dasid.code JOIN l_city_market_id dcid ON o.destcitymarketid = dcid.code JOIN l_state_fips dsf ON o.deststatefips = dsf.code JOIN l_world_area_codes dwac ON o.destwac = dwac.code JOIN l_deparrblk odb ON o.deptimeblk = odb.code JOIN l_deparrblk adb ON o.arrtimeblk = adb.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups odg ON o.departuredelaygroups = odg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups adg ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = adg.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 dg ON o.distancegroup = dg.code JOIN l_yesno_resp ync ON o.cancelled = ync.code JOIN l_yesno_resp ynd ON o.diverted = ynd.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance >= '0' AND o.distance <= '0' GROUP BY o.uniquecarrier HAVING COUNT(*) > 2024 AND AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) < '0' ) AS carrier_stats ORDER BY carrier_stats.total_flights DESC;

SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_ap_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_ap_dest.description AS dest_airport, l_m.description AS month_name, l_q.description AS quarter_name, l_dg.description AS distance_group, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(o.airtime) AS total_airtime, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_origin ON o.originairportid = l_ap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_ap_dest ON o.destairportid = l_ap_dest.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code JOIN l_quarters l_q ON o.quarter = l_q.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 l_dg ON o.distancegroup = l_dg.code JOIN l_airline_id l_ai ON o.airlineid = l_ai.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_cm_origin ON o.origincitymarketid = l_cm_origin.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_cm_dest ON o.destcitymarketid = l_cm_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf_origin ON o.originstatefips = l_sf_origin.code JOIN l_state_fips l_sf_dest ON o.deststatefips = l_sf_dest.code JOIN l_world_area_codes l_wac_origin ON o.originwac = l_wac_origin.code JOIN l_world_area_codes l_wac_dest ON o.destwac = l_wac_dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance >= '0' AND o.distance <= '0' AND o.depdelayminutes >= '0' AND o.depdelayminutes <= '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes >= '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes <= '0' GROUP BY l_uc.description, l_ap_origin.description, l_ap_dest.description, l_m.description, l_q.description, l_dg.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 430 AND AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, l_airline.description AS airline_name, l_airport_origin.description AS origin_airport, l_airport_dest.description AS dest_airport, l_months.description AS month_name, l_weekdays.description AS weekday_name, l_distance_group_250.description AS distance_group, l_ontime_delay_groups.description AS delay_group, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.cancelled) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(o.diverted) AS diverted_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_min, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_min, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(o.airtime) AS total_airtime, SUM(o.carrierdelay) AS total_carrier_delay, SUM(o.weatherdelay) AS total_weather_delay, SUM(o.nasdelay) AS total_nas_delay, SUM(o.securitydelay) AS total_security_delay, SUM(o.lateaircraftdelay) AS total_late_aircraft_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.depdelayminutes) AS median_dep_delay, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.arrdelayminutes) AS median_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id l_airline ON o.airlineid = l_airline.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_origin ON o.originairportid = l_airport_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id l_airport_dest ON o.destairportid = l_airport_dest.code JOIN l_months ON o.month = l_months.code JOIN l_weekdays ON o.dayofweek = l_weekdays.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ON o.distancegroup = l_distance_group_250.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = l_ontime_delay_groups.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_city_origin ON o.origincitymarketid = l_city_origin.code JOIN l_city_market_id l_city_dest ON o.destcitymarketid = l_city_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips l_state_origin ON o.originstatefips = l_state_origin.code JOIN l_state_fips l_state_dest ON o.deststatefips = l_state_dest.code JOIN l_world_area_codes l_wac_origin ON o.originwac = l_wac_origin.code JOIN l_world_area_codes l_wac_dest ON o.destwac = l_wac_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation l_cancel ON o.cancellationcode = l_cancel.code LEFT JOIN l_deparrblk l_deptimeblk ON o.deptimeblk = l_deptimeblk.code LEFT JOIN l_deparrblk l_arrtimeblk ON o.arrtimeblk = l_arrtimeblk.code LEFT JOIN l_yesno_resp l_cancelled ON o.cancelled = l_cancelled.code LEFT JOIN l_yesno_resp l_diverted ON o.diverted = l_diverted.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.quarter = 1 AND o.distance >= '0' AND o.depdelayminutes >= '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes >= '0' AND o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' GROUP BY o.airlineid, l_airline.description, l_airport_origin.description, l_airport_dest.description, l_months.description, l_weekdays.description, l_distance_group_250.description, l_ontime_delay_groups.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 797 AND AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' AND AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC, avg_dep_delay_min DESC LIMIT 739;

SELECT o.flightdate, o.origin, o.dest, o.arrdelay, AVG(o.arrdelay) OVER ( PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_arrdelay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-02' AND o.arrdelay IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate;

SELECT oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, oto.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_desc, lap_origin.description AS origin_airport_desc, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, lc.description AS cancellation_desc, SUM(oto.flights) AS total_flights, AVG(oto.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay_min, AVG(oto.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay_min, SUM(oto.distance) AS total_distance, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oto.cancelled = 1) AS cancelled_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE oto.diverted = 1) AS diverted_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oto.year, oto.quarter ORDER BY SUM(oto.flights) DESC) AS flight_volume_rank, LAG(SUM(oto.flights), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY oto.uniquecarrier, oto.month ORDER BY oto.year, oto.quarter) AS prev_quarter_flights, SUM(SUM(oto.flights)) OVER (PARTITION BY oto.year, oto.uniquecarrier ORDER BY oto.quarter ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_flights_year FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 oto JOIN l_airline_id la ON oto.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_origin ON oto.originairportid = lap_origin.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON oto.destairportid = lap_dest.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON oto.cancellationcode = lc.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON oto.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_months lm ON oto.month = lm.code JOIN l_quarters lq ON oto.quarter = lq.code JOIN l_weekdays lw ON oto.dayofweek = lw.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_dep ON oto.departuredelaygroups = lodg_dep.code LEFT JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_arr ON oto.arrivaldelaygroups = lodg_arr.code WHERE oto.year >= 2016 AND oto.month BETWEEN 11 AND 2 AND oto.distancegroup >= 1 AND oto.depdelayminutes > '0' GROUP BY oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, oto.uniquecarrier, la.description, lap_origin.description, lap_dest.description, lc.description HAVING SUM(oto.flights) > '1' AND AVG(oto.arrdelayminutes) < '0' ORDER BY oto.year, oto.quarter, oto.month, flight_volume_rank;

SELECT p.airlineid, p.origin, p.dest, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, AVG(p.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(p.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay, SUM(CASE WHEN p.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN p.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 p JOIN l_airline_id a ON p.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport o ON p.origin = o.code JOIN l_airport d ON p.dest = d.code JOIN l_cancellation c ON p.cancellationcode = c.code WHERE p.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND p.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND p.depdelay > 178.07 AND p.arrdelay > 94.96 AND p.distance BETWEEN '50' AND '50' AND p.month IN (6, 8, 11) AND p.dayofweek IN (3, 5) AND p.cancelled = 1 AND p.diverted = 1 GROUP BY p.airlineid, p.origin, p.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 163 AND AVG(p.depdelay) > 10.44 AND AVG(p.arrdelay) > 94.46 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, avg_arrival_delay DESC;

SELECT airlineid, flightnum, origin, dest, arrdelay, AVG(arrdelay) OVER (PARTITION BY airlineid ORDER BY flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 WHERE flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND airlineid = 19994 ORDER BY airlineid, flightdate;

SELECT l_uc.description AS carrier_name, l_m.description AS month_name, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_unique_carriers l_uc ON o.uniquecarrier = l_uc.code JOIN l_months l_m ON o.month = l_m.code JOIN l_airline_id l_ai ON o.airlineid = l_ai.code WHERE o.distancegroup BETWEEN 6 AND 5 AND o.year = 2016 GROUP BY l_uc.description, l_m.description HAVING AVG(o.depdelayminutes) > '0' ORDER BY total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, la.description AS airline_desc, o.origin, lap_orig.description AS origin_airport_desc, o.dest, lap_dest.description AS dest_airport_desc, COUNT(*) AS total_flights, SUM(o.flights) AS sum_flights, AVG(o.depdelayminutes) AS avg_dep_delay, AVG(o.arrdelayminutes) AS avg_arr_delay, SUM(o.distance) AS total_distance, SUM(o.cancelled) AS total_cancelled, SUM(o.diverted) AS total_diverted, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.year, o.quarter ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS flight_volume_rank, LAG(COUNT(*), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY o.uniquecarrier, o.origin, o.dest ORDER BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month) AS prev_month_flights, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY o.uniquecarrier ORDER BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS carrier_cumulative_flights FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id la ON o.airlineid = la.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_orig ON o.originairportid = lap_orig.code JOIN l_airport_id lap_dest ON o.destairportid = lap_dest.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcm_orig ON o.origincitymarketid = lcm_orig.code JOIN l_city_market_id lcm_dest ON o.destcitymarketid = lcm_dest.code JOIN l_state_fips lsf_orig ON o.originstatefips = lsf_orig.code JOIN l_state_fips lsf_dest ON o.deststatefips = lsf_dest.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 ldg ON o.distancegroup = ldg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_dep ON o.departuredelaygroups = lodg_dep.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups lodg_arr ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = lodg_arr.code LEFT JOIN l_cancellation lc ON o.cancellationcode = lc.code LEFT JOIN l_diversions ld ON o.divairportlandings = ld.code WHERE o.year >= 2016 AND o.month BETWEEN 11 AND 7 AND o.distance >= '0' AND o.depdelayminutes <= '0' AND o.arrdelayminutes <= '0' AND o.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, o.uniquecarrier, la.description, o.origin, lap_orig.description, o.dest, lap_dest.description HAVING COUNT(*) > 158 AND AVG(o.depdelayminutes) < '0' ORDER BY o.year, o.quarter, o.month, total_flights DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, AVG(o.depdelay) AS avg_departure_delay, AVG(o.arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay, COUNT(*) AS flight_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_flights, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.distance) AS median_distance FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig_airport ON o.origin = orig_airport.code JOIN l_airport dest_airport ON o.dest = dest_airport.code JOIN l_state_fips orig_state ON o.originstatefips = orig_state.code JOIN l_state_fips dest_state ON o.deststatefips = dest_state.code JOIN l_distance_group_250 dg ON o.distancegroup = dg.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups dep_delay_grp ON o.departuredelaygroups = dep_delay_grp.code JOIN l_ontime_delay_groups arr_delay_grp ON o.arrivaldelaygroups = arr_delay_grp.code WHERE o.year = 2016 AND o.month BETWEEN 12 AND 1 AND o.distance > '100.0' AND o.depdelay > 161.47 AND o.arrdelay > 7.93 AND o.cancelled = 0 GROUP BY o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest HAVING COUNT(*) > 946 AND AVG(o.depdelay) > 95.69 ORDER BY avg_departure_delay DESC, flight_count DESC;

SELECT o.airlineid, o.origin, o.dest, o.flightdate, o.depdel15, o.arrdel15, AVG(o.depdel15) OVER (PARTITION BY o.airlineid ORDER BY o.flightdate ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_dep_del15, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.origin, o.dest ORDER BY o.flightdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS recent_flights_on_route FROM on_time_on_time_performance_2016_1 o JOIN l_airline_id a ON o.airlineid = a.code JOIN l_airport orig ON o.origin = orig.code JOIN l_airport dest ON o.dest = dest.code WHERE o.flightdate >= '2016-01-01' AND o.flightdate <= '2016-01-01' AND o.distance > 1863.68 AND o.airlineid IN (SELECT code FROM l_airline_id WHERE code IN (20598, 19841)) AND o.originstatefips = 75 AND o.deststatefips = 20 ORDER BY o.flightdate DESC, o.airlineid;
